items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> m = n) /\ ((0 = 0 <-> True) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n = 0 <-> n = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 = 2 * n <-> 0 = n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 = 2 * n + 1 <-> False) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m = 2 * n <-> m = n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m = 2 * n + 1 <-> False) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 = 2 * n <-> False) /\ forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 = 2 * n + 1 <-> m = n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_EVEN
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, even_nat n <-> even_nat n) /\ ((even_nat 0 <-> True) /\ ((forall n :e omega, even_nat (2 * n) <-> True) /\ forall n :e omega, even_nat (2 * n + 1) <-> False))

items.name: ARITH_EXP
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m ^ n = m ^ n) /\ (0 ^ 0 = 1 /\ ((forall m :e omega, (2 * m) ^ 0 = 1) /\ ((forall m :e omega, (2 * m + 1) ^ 0 = 1) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 ^ (2 * n) = 0 ^ n * 0 ^ n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m) ^ (2 * n) = (2 * m) ^ n * (2 * m) ^ n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m + 1) ^ (2 * n) = (2 * m + 1) ^ n * (2 * m + 1) ^ n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 ^ (2 * n + 1) = 0) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m) ^ (2 * n + 1) = (2 * m) * (2 * m) ^ n * (2 * m) ^ n) /\ forall m n :e omega, (2 * m + 1) ^ (2 * n + 1) = (2 * m + 1) * (2 * m + 1) ^ n * (2 * m + 1) ^ n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_GE
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m <= n <-> m <= n) /\ (0 <= 0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n <= 0 <-> n <= 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ 2 * n + 1 <= 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 <= 2 * n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 <= 2 * n + 1) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m <= 2 * n <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m <= 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 <= 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 <= 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_GT
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m < n <-> m < n) /\ (~ 0 < 0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ 2 * n < 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ 2 * n + 1 < 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 < 2 * n <-> 0 < n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 < 2 * n + 1) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m < 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m < 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 < 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 < 2 * n + 1 <-> m < n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_LE
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m <= n <-> m <= n) /\ ((0 <= 0 <-> True) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n <= 0 <-> n <= 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 <= 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 <= 2 * n <-> True) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 <= 2 * n + 1 <-> True) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m <= 2 * n <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m <= 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 <= 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 <= 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_LT
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m < n <-> m < n) /\ ((0 < 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n < 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 < 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 < 2 * n <-> 0 < n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 < 2 * n + 1 <-> True) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m < 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m < 2 * n + 1 <-> m <= n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 < 2 * n <-> m < n) /\ forall m n :e omega, 2 * m + 1 < 2 * n + 1 <-> m < n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_MULT
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m * n = m * n) /\ (0 = 0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 * 2 * n = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 * (2 * n + 1) = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, (2 * n) * 0 = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, (2 * n + 1) * 0 = 0) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m) * 2 * n = 2 * 2 * m * n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m) * (2 * n + 1) = 2 * m + 2 * 2 * m * n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, (2 * m + 1) * 2 * n = 2 * n + 2 * 2 * m * n) /\ forall m n :e omega, (2 * m + 1) * (2 * n + 1) = (2 * m + 1) + 2 * n + 2 * 2 * m * n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_ODD
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> odd_nat n) /\ ((odd_nat 0 <-> False) /\ ((forall n :e omega, odd_nat (2 * n) <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, odd_nat (2 * n + 1) <-> True))

items.name: ARITH_PRE
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, nat_pred n = nat_pred n) /\ (nat_pred 0 = 0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, nat_pred (2 * n) = if n = 0 then 0 else 2 * nat_pred n + 1) /\ forall n :e omega, nat_pred (2 * n + 1) = 2 * n))

items.name: ARITH_SUB
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m n = minus_nat m n) /\ (minus_nat 0 0 = 0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, minus_nat 0 (2 * n) = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, minus_nat 0 (2 * n + 1) = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * n) 0 = 2 * n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * n + 1) 0 = 2 * n + 1) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * m) (2 * n) = 2 * minus_nat m n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * m) (2 * n + 1) = nat_pred (2 * minus_nat m n)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * m + 1) (2 * n) = if n <= m then 2 * minus_nat m n + 1 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (2 * m + 1) (2 * n + 1) = 2 * minus_nat m n))))))))

items.name: ARITH_SUC
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, ordsucc n = ordsucc n) /\ (1 = 1 /\ ((forall n :e omega, ordsucc (2 * n) = 2 * n + 1) /\ forall n :e omega, ordsucc (2 * n + 1) = 2 * ordsucc n))

items.name: ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall h :e A :*: B, forall t :e finseq (A :*: B), seq_assoc a (seq_cons h t) = if h 0 = a then h 1 else seq_assoc a t

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t -> R0 x x y y) /\ ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ (~ x = x' /\ (~ y = y' /\ R0 x x' y y'))))) -> R0 x' x y' y) /\ (countable s /\ (countable t /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ (finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s' /\ y :e s' -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s' /\ y :e s' -> R0 x y (f x) (f y))))))) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s :\: s' -> exists y :e B, y :e t :\: t' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z)) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t :\: t' -> exists x :e A, x :e s :\: s' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z))))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> R0 x y (f x) (f y)))

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH_2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t -> R0 x x y y) /\ ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ (~ x = x' /\ (~ y = y' /\ R0 x x' y y'))))) -> R0 x' x y' y) /\ (countable s /\ (countable t /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, forall x :e A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ (finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ ((forall x0 y :e A, x0 :e s' /\ y :e s' -> (f x0 = f y <-> x0 = y)) /\ ((forall x0 y :e A, x0 :e s' /\ y :e s' -> R0 x0 y (f x0) (f y)) /\ x :e s :\: s')))))) -> exists y :e B, y :e t :\: t' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z)) /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t' c= B, forall s' c= A, forall x :e B, finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ (finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ ({f x | x :e t'} = s' /\ ((forall x0 y :e B, x0 :e t' /\ y :e t' -> (f x0 = f y <-> x0 = y)) /\ ((forall x0 y :e B, x0 :e t' /\ y :e t' -> R0 (f x0) (f y) x0 y) /\ x :e t :\: t')))))) -> exists y :e A, y :e s :\: s' /\ forall z :e B, z :e t' -> R0 y (f z) x z))))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> R0 x y (f x) (f y)))

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ (countable t /\ (forall R0 c= A :*: B, finite R0 /\ (R0 c= s :*: t /\ (forall x y :e R0, x <> y -> P x y)) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ forall x0 y0 :e SetAdjoin R0 (x,y), x0 <> y0 -> P x0 y0) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall x0 y0 :e SetAdjoin R0 (x,y), x0 <> y0 -> P x0 y0)) -> exists R0 c= A :*: B, R0 c= s :*: t /\ ((forall x y :e R0, x <> y -> P x y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ (x,y) :e R0) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ (x,y) :e R0))

items.name: BASIS_CARD_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (v c= span A b /\ independent A b) -> finite b /\ finite_cardinality b = dim A v

items.name: BASIS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> basis N k i = if i = k then 1 else 0

items.name: BASIS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, basis N i = vec N 0 <-> ~ i :e idx N

items.name: BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx A, exists b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (independent A b /\ (v c= span A b /\ equip b (dim A v)))

items.name: BASIS_EXISTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx A, exists b c= R :^: idx A, finite b /\ (b c= v /\ (independent A b /\ (v c= span A b /\ equip b (dim A v))))

items.name: BASIS_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vsum omega N (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (x i) (basis N i)) = x

items.name: BASIS_EXPANSION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vsum omega N (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (f i) (basis N i)) = x <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> f i = x i

items.name: BASIS_HAS_SIZE_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, independent A b /\ span A b = v -> equip b (dim A v)

items.name: BASIS_HAS_SIZE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b /\ span N b = R :^: idx N -> equip b (dimindex N)

items.name: BASIS_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ basis N i = basis N j))) -> i = j

items.name: BASIS_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> (basis N i = basis N j <-> i = j)

items.name: BASIS_NE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> ~ basis N i = basis N j

items.name: BASIS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> ~ basis N k = vec N 0

items.name: BASIS_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, finite b -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, finite c /\ (finite_cardinality c <= finite_cardinality b /\ (span N c = span N b /\ forall x y :e c, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y))

items.name: BASIS_SUBSPACE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, finite b /\ (b c= s /\ (independent N b /\ (span N b = s /\ equip b (dim N s))))

items.name: BESSEL_INEQUALITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e s -> vector_norm N x0 = 1) -> finsum s (fun e0:set => dot N e0 x ^ 2) <= vector_norm N x ^ 2

items.name: BETA_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall y :e A, f y = f y

items.name: BETWEEN_1
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, between 1 x (a,b) <-> drop a <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop b \/ drop b <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop a

items.name: BETWEEN_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A b (a,c) -> a = b

items.name: BETWEEN_CMUL_LIFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, between N (vector_mul N c v) (vector_mul N a v,vector_mul N b v) <-> v = vec N 0 \/ between 1 (lift c) (lift a,lift b)

items.name: BETWEEN_COLLINEAR_DIST_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> collinear N {a,x,b} /\ (distance N (x,a) <= distance N (a,b) /\ distance N (x,b) <= distance N (a,b))

items.name: BETWEEN_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> dot N (vector_sub N x a) (vector_sub N b x) = vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)

items.name: BETWEEN_EXISTS_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N b (a,x) /\ ~ b = a -> exists d :e R, 0 <= d /\ x = vector_add N b (vector_mul N d (vector_sub N b a))

items.name: BETWEEN_IMP_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) -> collinear N {a,x,b}

items.name: BETWEEN_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, between A (midpoint A (a,b)) (a,b) /\ between A (midpoint A (a,b)) (b,a)

items.name: BETWEEN_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a)) (vector_sub N b x) = vector_mul N (vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)) (vector_sub N x a)

items.name: BETWEEN_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, between A a (a,b) /\ (between A b (a,b) /\ between A a (a,a))

items.name: BETWEEN_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,a) <-> x = a

items.name: BETWEEN_RESTRICTED_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) /\ (between N x (a,c) /\ ~ x = a) -> between N b (a,c) \/ between N c (a,b)

items.name: BETWEEN_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,b) <-> between A x (b,a)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A d (a,c) -> between A d (b,c)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall z a x y :e R :^: idx A, between A (vector_add A a x) (vector_add A a y,vector_add A a z) <-> between A x (y,z)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A d (a,b) -> between A a (c,d)

items.name: BIJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, bij s t f <-> inj s t f /\ ((forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ forall y :e t, exists x :e s, f x = y)

items.name: BIJECTIONS_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (finite s \/ finite t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)) -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ equip s n) -> equip t n

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) -> forall n :e omega, equip s n <-> equip t n

items.name: BIJECTIVE_INJECTIVE_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x) <-> (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y)

items.name: BIJECTIVE_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x) <-> (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e B, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))

items.name: BIJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x))

items.name: BIJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) -> ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)))

items.name: BILINEAR_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M h -> exists B :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm P (h x y) <= B * vector_norm M x * vector_norm N y

items.name: BILINEAR_BOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> bilinear B C A h -> exists B0 :e R, 0 < B0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm C (h x y) <= B0 * vector_norm A x * vector_norm B y

items.name: BILINEAR_DROP_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> bilinear N N 1 (fun x:set => fun y:set => vector_mul N (drop x) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear N P M f /\ (bilinear N P M g /\ (s c= span M b /\ (t c= span N c /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, x :e b /\ y :e c -> f x y = g x y)))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> f x y = g x y

items.name: BILINEAR_EQ_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M f /\ (bilinear N P M g /\ (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> f (basis M i) (basis N j) = g (basis M i) (basis N j))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f x x0 = g x x0

items.name: BILINEAR_LADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx B, forall z :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_add B x y) z = vector_add C (h x z) (h y z)

items.name: BILINEAR_LIFT_MUL
items.statement: bilinear 1 1 1 (fun x:set => fun y:set => lift (drop x * drop y))

items.name: BILINEAR_LMUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_mul B c x) y = vector_mul C c (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LNEG
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_neg B x) y = vector_neg C (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LSUB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx B, forall z :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_sub B x y) z = vector_sub C (h x z) (h y z)

items.name: BILINEAR_LSUM
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M bop /\ finite s -> bop (vsum A M s f) y = vsum A P s (fun i:set => bop (f i) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vec B 0) x = vec C 0

items.name: BILINEAR_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> bilinear (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex P)) (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex P)) (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun m1:set => fun m2:set => vectorize R M P (matrix_mul M N P (matrify R M N m1) (matrify R N P m2)))

items.name: BILINEAR_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> bilinear N M (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun m:set => fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (matrify R M N m) x)

items.name: BILINEAR_MUL_DROP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> bilinear 1 N N (fun y:set => fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop x) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_RADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_add B y z) = vector_add C (h x y) (h x z)

items.name: BILINEAR_RMUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_mul B c y) = vector_mul C c (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_RNEG
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_neg B y) = vector_neg C (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_RSUB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_sub B y z) = vector_sub C (h x y) (h x z)

items.name: BILINEAR_RSUM
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear N P M bop /\ finite s -> bop x (vsum A N s f) = vsum A P s (fun i:set => bop x (f i))

items.name: BILINEAR_RZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vec B 0) = vec C 0

items.name: BILINEAR_SWAP
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, op x y :e R :^: idx P) -> (bilinear M P N (fun x:set => fun y:set => op y x) <-> bilinear N P M op)

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B M N P:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M h /\ (finite s /\ finite t) -> h (vsum A M s f) (vsum B N t g) = vsum (A :*: B) P (s :*: t) (fun p:set => h (f (p 0)) (g (p 1)))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_CONVOLUTION_1
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, b x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, bilinear N P M bop -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun i:set => bop (a i) (b (minus_nat m i)))) = vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => bop (a m) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} b))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_CONVOLUTION_2
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, b x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, bilinear N P M bop -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun k:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= k} (fun i:set => bop (a i) (b (minus_nat k i))))) = vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => bop (vsum omega M {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} a) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} b))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall m n :e omega, bilinear N P M h -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (f k) (vector_sub N (g k) (g (minus_nat k 1)))) = if m <= n then vector_sub P (vector_sub P (h (f (n + 1)) (g n)) (h (f m) (g (minus_nat m 1)))) (vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (vector_sub M (f (k + 1)) (f k)) (g k))) else vec P 0

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall m n :e omega, bilinear N P M h -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (f k) (vector_sub N (g (k + 1)) (g k))) = if m <= n then vector_sub P (vector_sub P (h (f (n + 1)) (g (n + 1))) (h (f m) (g m))) (vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (vector_sub M (f (k + 1)) (f k)) (g (k + 1)))) else vec P 0

items.name: BINARY_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> P (2 * n) /\ P (2 * n + 1)) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: BIT0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: BIT0_DEF
items.statement: 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, 2 * ordsucc n = ordsucc (ordsucc (2 * n))

items.name: BIT0_THM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: BIT1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)

items.name: BIT1_DEF
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (2 * n)

items.name: BIT1_THM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)

items.name: BOOL_CASES_AX
items.statement: forall t:prop, (t <-> True) \/ (t <-> False)

items.name: BOUNDS_DIVIDED
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall n :e omega, P n <= B) <-> exists A B :e omega, forall n :e omega, n * P n <= A * n + B)

items.name: BOUNDS_IGNORE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> forall Q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, Q x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall i :e omega, P i <= Q i + B) <-> exists B N :e omega, forall i :e omega, N <= i -> P i <= Q i + B)

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B C :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B * n + C) <-> A <= B

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR_0
items.statement: forall A B :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B) <-> A = 0

items.name: BOUNDS_NOTZERO
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, P x y :e omega) -> forall A B :e omega, P 0 0 = 0 /\ (forall m n :e omega, P m n <= A * (m + n) + B) -> exists B0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, P m n <= B0 * (m + n)

items.name: BUTLAST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_butlast seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_butlast (seq_cons h t) = if t = seq_nil then seq_nil else seq_cons h (seq_butlast t)

items.name: BUTLAST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_butlast (seq_append l m) = if m = seq_nil then seq_butlast l else seq_append l (seq_butlast m)

items.name: BUTLAST_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> seq_butlast seq_nil = seq_nil /\ ((forall a :e A, seq_butlast (seq_cons a seq_nil) = seq_nil) /\ forall a h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_butlast (seq_cons a (seq_cons h t)) = seq_cons a (seq_butlast (seq_cons h t)))

items.name: CANTOR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s {t :e Power A | t c= s} /\ ~ equip s {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CANTOR_THM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> atleastp A (Power A) /\ ~ equip A (Power A)

items.name: CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite_cardinality s = set_foldr (fun x:set => fun n:set => ordsucc n) s 0

items.name: CARD_ADD2_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, infinite u /\ (atleastp s u /\ atleastp t u) -> atleastp (s :+: t) u

items.name: CARD_ADD2_ABSORB_LT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, infinite u /\ (atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u)) -> atleastp (s :+: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :+: t) u

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> atleastp (s :+: t) t

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> equip (s :+: t) t

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s /\ atleastp t s -> equip (s :+: t) s

items.name: CARD_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip (s :+: (t :+: u)) (s :+: t :+: u)

items.name: CARD_ADD_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :+: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_ADD_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> equip (s :+: t) (s' :+: t')

items.name: CARD_ADD_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_ADD_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :+: t) <-> finite s /\ finite t

items.name: CARD_ADD_LE_MUL_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> atleastp (s :+: s) (s :*: s)

items.name: CARD_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip (s :+: t) (t :+: s)

items.name: CARD_BOOL
items.statement: finite_cardinality 2 = 2

items.name: CARD_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite_cardinality (A :^: idx N) = finite_cardinality A ^ dimindex N

items.name: CARD_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite_cardinality Empty = 0 /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e s then finite_cardinality s else ordsucc (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: CARD_COLUMNS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, finite_cardinality (columns N M A) <= dimindex M

items.name: CARD_COUNTABLE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> (countable s <-> countable t)

items.name: CARD_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :*: t) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: {x}) = if x :e s then minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) 1 else finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: t) = minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) (finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_DIFF_ABSORB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ (atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s) -> equip (s :\: t) s

items.name: CARD_DIFF_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (equip s t /\ (equip s' t' /\ (infinite s -> atleastp s' s /\ ~ equip s' s)))) -> equip (s :\: s') (t :\: t')

items.name: CARD_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty -> equip (s :\/: t) (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_EMPTY_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, atleastp Empty s

items.name: CARD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finite_cardinality s = 0 <-> s = Empty)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite s \/ atleastp s t /\ atleastp s u) /\ equip (s :+: t) (s :+: u) -> equip t u

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_LCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite s \/ atleastp s t /\ atleastp s u -> (equip (s :+: t) (s :+: u) <-> equip t u)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite u \/ atleastp u s /\ atleastp u t) /\ equip (s :+: u) (t :+: u) -> equip s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_RCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite u \/ atleastp u s /\ atleastp u t -> (equip (s :+: u) (t :+: u) <-> equip s t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTIONS_SPECIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ (a :e s /\ b :e t))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ (f a = b /\ (g b = a /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)))

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> (equip s t <-> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARD_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ equip s t -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_EQ_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> infinite A -> equip (A :^: idx N) A

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall t :e Power B :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> equip (s i) (t i)) -> equip {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} {f :e B :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: K, forall k l c= K, k :/\: l = Empty -> equip {f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k :\/: l, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k :\/: l -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} ({f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :*: {f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e l, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e l -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)})

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> (equip s t <-> equip s' t')

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, countable t /\ equip s t -> countable s

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE_SUBSETS_REAL
items.statement: equip {s :e Power R | countable s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE_SUBSETS_SUBREAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ atleastp s R -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ countable t} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ equip b (dim A v) -> (independent A b <-> v c= span A b)

items.name: CARD_EQ_DISJOINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (forall u c= A, u :e s -> equip u t) -> equip (Union s) (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, equip s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CARD_EQ_EXP_INFINITE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s /\ (finite t /\ ~ t = Empty) -> equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FINITE
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, finite t /\ equip s t -> finite s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FINITE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ finite t} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FULLSIZE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ equip t s} {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CARD_EQ_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> equip {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ {x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s} {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> equip {f x | x :e s} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (f x = f y <-> g x = g y)) -> equip {f x | x :e s} {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGE_MUL_FIBRES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= C, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip {z :e A | z :e s /\ f z = f x} t) -> equip ({f x | x :e s} :*: t) s

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMP_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ equip s t -> infinite s

items.name: CARD_EQ_INTEGER
items.statement: equip {x :e R | x :e int} omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_INT_NUM
items.statement: equip int omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIMITED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s -> (atleastp t s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ atleastp k t} {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}) /\ (~ atleastp t s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ atleastp k t} {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)})

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> infinite A -> equip (finseq A) A

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIST_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {l :e finseq A | forall x :e A, seq_mem x l -> x :e s} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality s = finsum s (fun x:set => 1)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ORDINAL_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, exists l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ equip (fld_on A l) s

items.name: CARD_EQ_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, equip (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (f x :e t /\ (f y :e t /\ f x = f y))) -> x = y) /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> equip {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} t

items.name: CARD_EQ_RATIONAL
items.statement: equip {x :e R | x :e rational} omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL
items.statement: equip R (Power omega)

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_IMP_UNCOUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s R -> ~ countable s

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_SEQUENCES
items.statement: equip (R :^: omega) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a b :e R, a < b /\ (forall x :e R, a < x /\ x < b -> x :e s) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s s

items.name: CARD_EQ_REFL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s = t -> equip s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> infinite s /\ (~ (exists a :e B, t c= {a}) /\ {k x | x :e s} c= t) -> equip {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})} (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ equip k t} (if atleastp t s then {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} else Empty)

items.name: CARD_EQ_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality s = finsum s (fun x:set => 1)

items.name: CARD_EQ_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> equip t s

items.name: CARD_EQ_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip s t /\ equip t u -> equip s u

items.name: CARD_EXP_0
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall c :e C, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e Empty, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e Empty -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {c}

items.name: CARD_EXP_ABSORB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ (atleastp 2 s /\ atleastp s {f :e 2 :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}) -> equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e 2 :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_ADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip {f :e A :^: (B :+: C) | (forall x :e t :+: u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B :+: C, ~ x :e t :+: u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} ({f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} :*: {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)})

items.name: CARD_EXP_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = finite_cardinality s ^ finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_EXP_CANTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)} /\ ~ equip s {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> equip {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e B :^: D | (forall x :e t', f x :e s') /\ forall x :e D, ~ x :e t' -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_EQ_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, countable s /\ ~ s = Empty -> equip {f :e R :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e R) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in R (fun y:set => False)} R

items.name: CARD_EXP_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} <-> (exists a :e A, s c= {a}) \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: CARD_EXP_GRAPH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {R0 :e Power A :^: B | (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, y :e R0 x -> x :e t /\ y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, y :e R0 x /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e R0 x -> y0 = y}

items.name: CARD_EXP_GRAPH_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {R0 :e Power (B :*: A) | (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, (x,y) :e R0 -> x :e t /\ y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, (x,y) :e R0 /\ forall y0 :e A, (x,y0) :e R0 -> y0 = y}

items.name: CARD_EXP_LE_REAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s R /\ countable t -> atleastp {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} R

items.name: CARD_EXP_MUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip {f :e A :^: (B :*: C) | (forall x :e t :*: u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B :*: C, ~ x :e t :*: u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e A :^: B :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in (A :^: B) (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)} {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CARD_EXP_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall b :e B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e {b}, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e {b} -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} s

items.name: CARD_EXP_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e B, f x :e A) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e B -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = A :^: B

items.name: CARD_EXP_ZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall c :e C, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e s, f x :e Empty) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} (if s = Empty then {c} else Empty)

items.name: CARD_FINITE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> (finite s <-> finite t)

items.name: CARD_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite_cardinality (idx A) = dimindex A

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d} = finite_cardinality t ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_CONG
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> equip A A_ /\ equip B B_ -> equip (B :^: A) (B_ :^: A_)

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_CURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> equip (C :^: B :^: A) (C :^: (A :*: B))

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> atleastp A A_ /\ atleastp B B_ -> atleastp (B :^: A) (B_ :^: A_)

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> finite A /\ finite B -> finite_cardinality (B :^: A) = finite_cardinality B ^ finite_cardinality A

items.name: CARD_GE_DIM_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ dim N v <= finite_cardinality b) -> v c= span N b

items.name: CARD_GE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> atleastp t {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CARD_HAS_SIZE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall n :e omega, equip s t -> (equip s n <-> equip t n)

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_EQ_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} = finite_cardinality s <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ finite s -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} = finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x)) -> finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LE2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= finite_cardinality {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LT2

items.name: CARD_INFINITE_CONG

items.name: CARD_INTSEG_INT

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_LCANCEL_EQ

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_RCANCEL_EQ

items.name: CARD_LE_CARD

items.name: CARD_LE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT

items.name: CARD_LE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SUBINDEX

items.name: CARD_LE_EXP

items.name: CARD_LE_EXP_LEFT

items.name: CARD_MUL_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: CARD_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall a :e A, forall t c= B, equip ({a} :*: t) t

items.name: CARD_MUL_LT_INFINITE
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u /\ infinite u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL_LT_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A C B:set, A <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u /\ infinite u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL_RID
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall b :e B, equip (s :*: {b}) s

items.name: CARD_MUL_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip (s :*: t) (t :*: s)

items.name: CARD_NOT_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, ~ atleastp s t <-> atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s

items.name: CARD_NOT_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, ~ (atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t) <-> atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, finite_cardinality {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality (idx_n n) = n

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality {m :e omega | m <= n} = n + 1

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m d :e omega, finite_cardinality {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= m + d} = d + 1

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality {m :e omega | m < n} = n

items.name: CARD_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality {t :e Power A | t c= s} = 2 ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_POWERSET_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> equip {u :e Power A | u c= s} {v :e Power B | v c= t}

items.name: CARD_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ a <> b /\ finite b -> finite_cardinality a < finite_cardinality b

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, finite b /\ a c= b -> (a c= b /\ a <> b <-> finite_cardinality a < finite_cardinality b)

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ ~ finite_cardinality a = finite_cardinality b -> a c= b /\ a <> b

items.name: CARD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip ((s :+: t) :*: u) (s :*: u :+: t :*: u)

items.name: CARD_ROWS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, finite_cardinality (rows N M A) <= dimindex N

items.name: CARD_SET_OF_LIST_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, finite_cardinality (seq_set l) <= seq_len l

items.name: CARD_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, finite_cardinality {a} = 1

items.name: CARD_SING_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall a :e A, forall s c= B, atleastp {a} s <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: CARD_SQUARE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= A, infinite k -> equip (k :*: k) k

items.name: CARD_SQUARE_NUM
items.statement: equip (omega :*: omega) omega

items.name: CARD_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> finite_cardinality {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = dimindex N

items.name: CARD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ finite b -> finite_cardinality a <= finite_cardinality b

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, finite b /\ (a c= b /\ finite_cardinality a = finite_cardinality b) -> a = b

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, finite t /\ s c= {f x | x :e t} -> finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, finite b /\ (a c= b /\ finite_cardinality b <= finite_cardinality a) -> a = b

items.name: CARD_SUSLIN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, equip C R -> equip (suslin A C) R

items.name: CARD_SUSLIN_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, atleastp C R -> atleastp (suslin A C) R

items.name: CARD_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t u c= A, t :e s /\ (u :e s /\ ~ t = u) -> t :/\: u = Empty)) -> finite_cardinality (Union s) = finsum s (fun x:set => finite_cardinality x)

items.name: CARD_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: K, forall s c= K, finite s /\ ((forall t :e K, t :e s -> finite (f t)) /\ (forall t u :e K, t :e s /\ (u :e s /\ ~ t = u) -> f t :/\: f u = Empty)) -> finite_cardinality (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality (f i))

items.name: CARD_UNIONS_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x) /\ finite_cardinality (t x) <= n) -> finite_cardinality (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) <= m * n

items.name: CARD_UNION_ABSORB_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> equip (s :\/: t) t

items.name: CARD_UNION_ABSORB_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ atleastp t s -> equip (s :\/: t) s

items.name: CARD_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality u

items.name: CARD_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = minus_nat (finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t) (finite_cardinality (s :/\: t))

items.name: CARD_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) <= finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_UNION_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) < finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t) -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: CARD_UNION_OVERLAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> (finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, f i :e if i :e k then s i else {choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_AS_RESTRICTIONS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {(fun x :e K => if x :e k then f x else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) | f :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f :e A :^: B | (forall i :e t, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s}) /\ forall i :e B, ~ i :e t -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e Empty, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e Empty -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {fun i :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty /\ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = t i

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty <-> exists i :e K, i :e k /\ s i = Empty

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_MEMBERS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x y :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ (y :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i = y i)) -> x = y

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_MEMBERS_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x y :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ y :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} -> (x = y <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i = y i)

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SINGS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e {x i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {x}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SINGS_GEN
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e K, x x :e A) -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e {x i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then x x0 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e K, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e A}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e K -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = A :^: K

items.name: CART_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx B, x = y <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> x i = y i

items.name: CART_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx N, x = y <-> forall i :e omega, x i = y i

items.name: CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, chain_on A l s <-> s c= fld_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: CHAIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, chain_on A l s /\ t c= s -> chain_on A l t

items.name: CHOICE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s) = choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)

items.name: CHOICE_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, ~ s = Empty -> choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s) :e s

items.name: CHOICE_PAIRED_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) /\ (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> Q (x,y)) -> Q (choose_in (A :*: B) (fun x:set => P (x 0) (x 1)))

items.name: CHOICE_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, choose_in (A :*: B) (fun x:set => P (x 0) (x 1)) = choose_in (A :*: B) (fun p:set => P (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> forall n :e omega, n <= finite_cardinality s -> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s u c= A, s c= u /\ (finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s <= n /\ (finite u -> n <= finite_cardinality u))) -> exists t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ equip t n)

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, (finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s) -> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSPACE_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, n <= dim N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N t /\ (t c= span N s /\ dim N t = n)

items.name: COLLINEAR_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, collinear 1 s

items.name: COLLINEAR_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {x,y}

items.name: COLLINEAR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,y,z} <-> collinear A {vec A 0,vector_sub A x y,vector_sub A z y}

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_2D
items.statement: forall x y z :e R :^: idx_n 2, collinear (idx_n 2) {x,y,z} <-> (z 1 + - x 1) * (y 2 + - x 2) = (y 1 + - x 1) * (z 2 + - x 2)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_DOT_MULTIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> vector_mul N (dot N (vector_sub N b a) (vector_sub N b a)) (vector_sub N c a) = vector_mul N (dot N (vector_sub N c a) (vector_sub N b a)) (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_EXPAND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> a = c \/ exists u :e R, b = vector_add N (vector_mul N u a) (vector_mul N (1 + - u) c)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} /\ (collinear N {b,c,d} /\ ~ b = c) -> collinear N {a,b,d}

items.name: COLLINEAR_4_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> (collinear N {a,b,c,d} <-> collinear N {a,b,c} /\ collinear N {a,b,d})

items.name: COLLINEAR_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists c :e R, x = vector_add N u (vector_mul N c v)

items.name: COLLINEAR_ALT2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists c :e R, vector_sub N x u = vector_mul N c v

items.name: COLLINEAR_BETWEEN_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> between N a (b,c) \/ (between N b (c,a) \/ between N c (a,b))

items.name: COLLINEAR_BETWEEN_CASES_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, between N c (a,b) /\ between N d (a,b) -> between N d (a,c) \/ between N d (c,b)

items.name: COLLINEAR_DIST_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,a,b} /\ (distance A (x,a) <= distance A (a,b) /\ distance A (x,b) <= distance A (a,b)) -> between A x (a,b)

items.name: COLLINEAR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> collinear A Empty

items.name: COLLINEAR_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {vec N 0,x,y} <-> x = vec N 0 \/ (y = vec N 0 \/ exists c :e R, y = vector_mul N c x)

items.name: COLLINEAR_LEMMA_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {vec A 0,x,y} <-> x = vec A 0 \/ exists c :e R, y = vector_mul A c x

items.name: COLLINEAR_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {a,midpoint A (a,b),b}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SMALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= 2 -> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {vec N 0,a,b} <-> a = vec N 0 \/ b :e span N {a}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, collinear A t /\ s c= t -> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_TRIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> (collinear N (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s b) a) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> collinear N {a,b,x})

items.name: COLUMNS_IMAGE_BASIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, columns N M A = {matrix_vector_mul N M A x | x :e {basis M i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M}}

items.name: COLUMNS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, ~ columns M N A = Empty

items.name: COLUMNS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, columns N M (transp M N A) = rows M N A

items.name: COLUMN_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, column N N i (mat N N 0) = vec N 0

items.name: COLUMN_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex P -> column M P i (matrix_mul M N P A B) = matrix_vector_mul M N A (column N P i B)

items.name: COLUMN_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> column N M i (transp M N A) = row M N i A

items.name: COMMA_DEF
items.error: internal constant ABS_prod (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: COMMUTING_MATRIX_INV_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M M M (matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)) (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = matrix_mul M M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) (matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A))

items.name: COMMUTING_MATRIX_INV_NORMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N A (matrix_inv N N A)

items.name: COMPL_COMPL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, A :\: (A :\: s) = s

items.name: COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e SetAdjoin s x

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_INFNORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= infnorm N x

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, abs_SNo (x i) <= vector_norm N x

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e omega, linear M N f -> abs_SNo (matrix M N f i j) <= onorm M N f

items.name: COND_ABS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall b:prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if b then f x else g x) = if b then f x else g x

items.name: COND_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t1 t2 :e A, (if True then t1 else t2) = t1 /\ (if False then t1 else t2) = t2

items.name: COND_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b:prop, forall x y :e A :^: idx B, forall i :e omega, (if b then x else y) i = if b then x i else y i

items.name: COND_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t:prop, forall t1 t2 :e A, (if t then t1 else t2) = choose_in A (fun x:set => ((t <-> True) -> x = t1) /\ ((t <-> False) -> x = t2))

items.name: COND_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall c:prop, forall x y :e A, P (if c then x else y) <-> (c -> P x) /\ (~ c -> P y)

items.name: COND_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b:prop, forall t :e A, (if b then t else t) = t

items.name: COND_RAND
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b:prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x y :e A, f (if b then x else y) = if b then f x else f y

items.name: COND_RATOR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall b:prop, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (if b then f x else g x) = if b then f x else g x

items.name: COND_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:prop, forall x y :e A, (if ~ p then x else y) = if p then y else x

items.name: CONG
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> mod_nat x n = mod_nat y n

items.name: CONG_DIV2
items.statement: forall a b m n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + (m * n) * q1 = b + (m * n) * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, div_nat a m + n * q1 = div_nat b m + n * q2

items.name: CONG_LMOD
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, mod_nat x n + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2

items.name: CONG_NSUM
