items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, f x + n * q1 = g x + n * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, finsum s f + n * q1 = finsum s g + n * q2

items.name: CONG_RMOD
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = mod_nat y n + n * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2

items.name: CONJ_ASSOC
items.statement: forall t1 t2 t3:prop, t1 /\ (t2 /\ t3) <-> t1 /\ t2 /\ t3

items.name: CONJ_SYM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, t1 /\ t2 <-> t2 /\ t1

items.name: CONS_11
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h1 h2 :e A, forall t1 t2 :e finseq A, seq_cons h1 t1 = seq_cons h2 t2 <-> h1 = h2 /\ t1 = t2

items.name: CONS_HD_TL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> l = seq_cons (seq_hd l) (seq_tl l)

items.name: CONTRAPOS_THM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, ~ t1 -> ~ t2 <-> t2 -> t1

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_INCREASING
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R) -> forall b :e R, (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s m <= s n) /\ (forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (s n) <= b) -> exists l :e R, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> abs_SNo (s n + - l) < e0

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R) -> forall b :e R, (forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (s n) <= b) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s m <= s n) \/ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n <= s m)) -> exists l :e R, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> abs_SNo (s n + - l) < e0

items.name: COPRIME_LMOD
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, gcd_int (mod_nat a n) n = 1 <-> gcd_int a n = 1

items.name: COPRIME_RMOD
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, gcd_int n (mod_nat a n) = 1 <-> gcd_int n a = 1

items.name: COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t c= A, countable t <-> atleastp t omega

items.name: COUNTABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s <-> atleastp s omega

items.name: COUNTABLE_ASCENDING_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> exists u :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, u n :e f) /\ ((forall n :e omega, u n c= u (ordsucc n)) /\ Union {u n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union f)

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, countable s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ s = {f x | x :e omega}

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_IMAGE_NUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ exists k c= omega, s = {f x | x :e k}

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ s c= {f x | x :e omega}

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_IMAGE_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ s c= {f x | x :e omega}

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s /\ infinite s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ (s = {f x | x :e omega} /\ forall m n :e omega, f m = f n -> m = n)

items.name: COUNTABLE_AS_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ exists k c= omega, s = {f x | x :e k} /\ forall m n :e omega, m :e k /\ (n :e k /\ f m = f n) -> m = n

items.name: COUNTABLE_CARD_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (s :+: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_CARD_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable (s :+: t) <-> countable s /\ countable t

items.name: COUNTABLE_CARD_MUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (s :*: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_CARD_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ countable s /\ countable t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> countable {x :e A | P i x}) -> countable {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)}

items.name: COUNTABLE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, countable {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, s i c= {a}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> countable (s i)

items.name: COUNTABLE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s <-> finite s \/ equip s omega

items.name: COUNTABLE_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (s :*: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, countable (s :\: {x}) <-> countable s

items.name: COUNTABLE_DESCENDING_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> exists u :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, u n :e f) /\ ((forall n :e omega, u (ordsucc n) c= u n) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e {u n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y})

items.name: COUNTABLE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, countable s -> countable (s :\: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_DIFF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite s -> (countable (t :\: s) <-> countable t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_DISJOINT_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, u :e {x0 :e Power (Power A) | countable x0} :/\: {x0 :e Power (Power A) | forall x y :e x0, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty} /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, u :e {x1 :e Power (Power A) | countable x1} :/\: {x1 :e Power (Power A) | forall x y :e x1, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty} /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, u :e {x0 :e Power (Power A) | countable x0} :/\: {x0 :e Power (Power A) | forall x y :e x0, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty} /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> countable Empty

items.name: COUNTABLE_FINITE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s -> countable {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ finite t}

items.name: COUNTABLE_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, countable (fld_on A l) <-> countable (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, l x y})

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, countable s -> countable {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, countable {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t})

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_EQ_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, countable {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} /\ forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ countable A0 -> countable {x :e A | f x :e A0}

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (countable {f x | x :e s} <-> countable s)

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_INJ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ countable A0 -> countable {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e A0}

items.name: COUNTABLE_IMP_CARD_LT_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s -> atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R

items.name: COUNTABLE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, countable (SetAdjoin s x) <-> countable s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTEGER
items.statement: countable {x :e R | x :e int}

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTEGER_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> countable {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e int}

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, countable s \/ countable t -> countable (s :/\: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_BIJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P P':set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall s c= A, P' {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)) -> forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power B, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P' c) /\ {x :e B | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ Union u = A :\: s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x0) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e P) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u = relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u0, x0 :e Y} = x} u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u s c= A, P u -> (s :e relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u <-> (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ s c= u)

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = Empty) /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = Union u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = Union u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> countable A -> countable (finseq A)

items.name: COUNTABLE_LIST_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s -> countable {l :e finseq A | forall x :e A, seq_mem x l -> x :e s}

items.name: COUNTABLE_LOCAL_MAXIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {f x | x :e R, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d -> f x' <= f x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_LOCAL_MINIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {f x | x :e R, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d -> f x <= f x'}

items.name: COUNTABLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: COUNTABLE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, countable (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ countable s /\ countable t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, countable s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> countable (t x)) -> countable (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x})

items.name: COUNTABLE_RATIONAL
items.statement: countable {x :e R | x :e rational}

items.name: COUNTABLE_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> countable {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational}

items.name: COUNTABLE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, countable s -> countable {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> countable s /\ countable t -> countable {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})}

items.name: COUNTABLE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, countable {x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_STRICT_LOCAL_MAXIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {x :e R | exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d /\ ~ x' = x -> f x' < f x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_STRICT_LOCAL_MINIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {x :e R | exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d /\ ~ x' = x -> f x < f x'}

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, countable t /\ s c= t -> countable s

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} <-> exists s' c= A, countable s' /\ (s' c= s /\ t = {f x | x :e s'})

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET_NUM
items.statement: forall s c= omega, countable s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, countable (s :\/: t) <-> countable s /\ countable t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall A0 c= Power A, countable A0 /\ (forall s c= A, s :e A0 -> countable s) -> countable (Union A0)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (s :\/: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_ASCENDING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P Empty /\ (forall t u c= A, P t /\ P u -> P (t :\/: u)) -> ((exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, P (t n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= t (ordsucc n)) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s))

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BIJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P P':set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall s c= A, P' {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)) -> forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power B, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P' c) /\ Union u = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A :\: s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P Empty -> ((exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, P (t n)) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = A) /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u x c= A, x :e relative_to A {x0 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e P) /\ Union u = x0} u <-> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ Union u0 = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = Union u

items.name: COVARIANCE_MATRIX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A = mat N N 0 <-> A = mat M N 0

items.name: COVARIANCE_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N (matrix_inv M N A)) (matrix_inv M N A) = matrix_inv N N (matrix_mul N M N A (transp N M A))

items.name: CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, s :*: t = \/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: CROSS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :\: u = (s :*: t) :\: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :\: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :\: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall C D A B:set, (forall s c= A, s :*: Empty = Empty) /\ forall t c= B, Empty :*: t = Empty

items.name: CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s :*: t = s' :*: t' <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

items.name: CROSS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, s :*: t = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: CROSS_INTER
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :/\: u = (s :*: t) :/\: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :/\: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :/\: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s :*: {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then s :*: A else {x :e A :*: A | forall Y :e {s :*: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall t c= B, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :*: t = if f = Empty then A :*: t else {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {s :*: t | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: CROSS_INTERS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall g c= Power B, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :*: {x :e B | forall Y :e g, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {A :*: t | t :e Power B, t :e g}, x :e Y} else if g = Empty then {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {s :*: B | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y} else {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e (\/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e f /\ t :e g}), x :e Y}

items.name: CROSS_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> s :*: t c= s' :*: t'

items.name: CROSS_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, {x} :*: {y} = {(x,y)}

items.name: CROSS_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :\/: u = (s :*: t) :\/: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :\/: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :\/: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s :*: Union f = Union {s :*: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall t c= B, Union f :*: t = Union {s :*: t | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: CROSS_UNIONS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall g c= Power B, Union f :*: Union g = Union (\/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e f /\ t :e g})

items.name: CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A :*: B = A :*: B

items.name: CURRY_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f (x,y) = f (x,y)

items.name: DECIMAL
items.statement: forall x y :e omega, x :/: y = x :/: y

items.name: DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s <-> exists t c= A, s = SetAdjoin t x /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s :\: {x} = {y :e A | y :e s /\ ~ y = x}

items.name: DELETE_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, (s :\: {x}) :\: {y} = (s :\: {y}) :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (s :\: {x}) :\: {x} = s :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\: {y} = if x = y then s :\: {y} else SetAdjoin (s :\: {y}) x

items.name: DELETE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, (s :\: {x}) :/\: t = s :/\: t :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_NON_ELEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ x :e s <-> s :\: {x} = s

items.name: DELETE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, s :\: {x} c= s

items.name: DEPENDENT_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, dependent N {a,b} <-> (a = b -> a = vec N 0) /\ (~ a = b -> exists x y :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_mul N y b) = vec N 0 /\ ~ (x = 0 /\ y = 0))

items.name: DEPENDENT_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ ~ b = c) -> (dependent N {a,b,c} <-> exists x y z :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_add N (vector_mul N y b) (vector_mul N z c)) = vec N 0 /\ ~ (x = 0 /\ (y = 0 /\ z = 0)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dimindex N < finite_cardinality s) -> dependent N s

items.name: DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dim N s < finite_cardinality s) -> dependent N s

items.name: DEPENDENT_CHOICE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, (exists a :e A, P 0 a) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, P n x -> exists y :e A, P (ordsucc n) y /\ R0 n x y) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, P n (f n)) /\ forall n :e omega, R0 n (f n) (f (ordsucc n)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_CHOICE_FIXED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, P 0 a /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, P n x -> exists y :e A, P (ordsucc n) y /\ R0 n x y) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ (f 0 = a /\ ((forall n :e omega, P n (f n)) /\ forall n :e omega, R0 n (f n) (f (ordsucc n))))

items.name: DEPENDENT_EQ_DIM_LT_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dependent N s <-> finite s -> dim N s < finite_cardinality s

items.name: DEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, dependent N p <-> exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> (dependent N s <-> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0))

items.name: DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ dependent M s) -> dependent N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (dependent N {f x | x :e s} <-> dependent M s)

items.name: DEPENDENT_MONO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, dependent N s /\ s c= t -> dependent N t

items.name: DEPENDENT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dependent A {x} <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: DICKSON
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, x x y :e omega) -> exists i j :e omega, i < j /\ forall k :e omega, k < n -> x i k <= x j k

items.name: DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\: t = {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ x :e t}

items.name: DIFF_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, (s :\: t) :\: t = s :\: t

items.name: DIFF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: Empty = s

items.name: DIFF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: s = Empty

items.name: DIFF_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, s :\: SetAdjoin t x = (s :\: {x}) :\: t

items.name: DIFF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = Union {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}

items.name: DIFF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :\: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :\: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: Union s = u :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty -> u :\: Union s = {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ t c= s -> Union s :\: Union t = Union (s :\: t)

items.name: DIFF_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: A = Empty

items.name: DIMINDEX_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, 1 = 1 /\ (2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A /\ 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1)

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> dimindex (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) = if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimindex (idx A) = dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_PROD
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M * dimindex N = dimindex M * dimindex N

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M + dimindex N = dimindex M + dimindex N

items.name: DIMINDEX_GE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> 1 <= dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_PROD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (dimindex M * dimindex N)

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (dimindex M + dimindex N)

items.name: DIMINDEX_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ dimindex A = 0

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT0
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT1
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, equip A n -> dimindex A = n

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, dimindex A = dimindex A

items.name: DIM_BASIS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, dim N {basis N x | x :e k} = finite_cardinality (idx N :/\: k)

items.name: DIM_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dim N Empty = 0

items.name: DIM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = 0 <-> s c= {vec N 0}

items.name: DIM_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s -> dim N s = finite_cardinality s

items.name: DIM_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = dimindex N <-> span N s = R :^: idx N

items.name: DIM_EQ_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ dim N t <= dim N s -> span N s = span N t

items.name: DIM_EQ_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ s c= t) -> (dim N s = dim N t <-> s = t)

items.name: DIM_EQ_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ (s c= t /\ dim N t <= dim N s)) -> s = t

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_KERNEL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> dim N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = vec N 0} = dimindex M

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_KERNEL_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ subspace M s -> dim N {f x | x :e s} + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = vec N 0} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> ~ c x = 0) -> dim N {vector_mul N (c x) x | x :e s} = dim N s

items.name: DIM_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_INJECTIVE_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (subspace M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e span N s then dim N s else dim N s + 1

items.name: DIM_INSERT_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0)) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_KERNEL_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> linear M N f /\ linear N P g -> dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | g (f x) = vec P 0} <= dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = vec N 0} + dim N {y :e R :^: idx N | g y = vec P 0}

items.name: DIM_LE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> dim A s <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: DIM_LINEAR_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> dim N {f x | x :e s} <= dim M s

items.name: DIM_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> dot N x y = 0) -> dim N (s :\/: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ subspace N t -> dim (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = dim M s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PCROSS_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (vec M 0 :e s \/ vec N 0 :e t)) -> dim (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = dim M s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s c= span N t /\ span N s <> span N t -> dim N s < dim N t

items.name: DIM_ROWS_LE_DIM_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, dim M (rows N M A) <= dim N (columns N M A)

items.name: DIM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dim A {x} = if x = vec A 0 then 0 else 1

items.name: DIM_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (span N s) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_SPECIAL_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = 0} = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: DIM_SPECIAL_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ i :e k) -> x i = 0} = finite_cardinality (idx N :\: k)

items.name: DIM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> dim N s <= dim N t

items.name: DIM_SUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s <= dimindex N

items.name: DIM_SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ s c= t) -> dim N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N x y} + dim N s = dim N t

items.name: DIM_SUMS_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> dim N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) + dim N (s :/\: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_UNION_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> dim N (s :\/: t) + dim N (s :/\: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (v c= span A b /\ (independent A b /\ equip b n)) -> dim A v = n

items.name: DIM_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dim N (R :^: idx N) = dimindex N

items.name: DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, (s :*: t) :/\: (s' :*: t') = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_DELETE_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, (s :\: {x}) :/\: t = Empty <-> (t :\: {x}) :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :/\: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :/\: t i = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty :/\: s = Empty /\ s :/\: Empty = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = Empty <-> s :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: DISJOINT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i < a i \/ (d i < c i \/ (b i < c i \/ d i < a i)))))) /\ ((closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: open_interval N (c,d) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i < a i \/ (d i <= c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))) /\ ((open_interval N (a,b) :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i <= a i \/ (d i < c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))) /\ (open_interval N (a,b) :/\: open_interval N (c,d) = Empty <-> exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i <= a i \/ (d i <= c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))))

items.name: DISJOINT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :/\: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} = Empty <-> n < p \/ (q < m \/ (n < m \/ q < p))

items.name: DISJOINT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, forall a :e A, s :/\: {a} = Empty <-> ~ a :e s) /\ forall s c= A, forall a :e A, {a} :/\: s = Empty <-> ~ a :e s

items.name: DISJOINT_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> t :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, (s :\/: t) :/\: u = Empty <-> s :/\: u = Empty /\ t :/\: u = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = t i

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = Empty

items.name: DISJ_ASSOC
items.statement: forall t1 t2 t3:prop, t1 \/ (t2 \/ t3) <-> t1 \/ t2 \/ t3

items.name: DISJ_SYM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, t1 \/ t2 <-> t2 \/ t1

items.name: DIST_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,vec A 0) = vector_norm A x /\ distance A (vec A 0,x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: DIST_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance 1 (x,y) = abs_SNo (drop x + - drop y)

items.name: DIST_ADD2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (p + q)) <= abs_SNo (m + - p) + abs_SNo (n + - q)

items.name: DIST_ADD2_REV
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (p + q)) + abs_SNo (n + - q)

items.name: DIST_ADDBOUND
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= m + n

items.name: DIST_DESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= a /\ (0 <= b /\ vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y) -> (if a <= b then a else b) * distance N (x,y) <= distance N (vector_mul N a x,vector_mul N b y)

items.name: DIST_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall x y :e omega, P (abs_SNo (x + - y)) <-> forall d :e omega, (x = y + d -> P d) /\ (y = x + d -> P d)

items.name: DIST_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall w x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, distance A (w,x) = distance B (y,z) <-> distance A (w,x) ^ 2 = distance B (y,z) ^ 2

items.name: DIST_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = 0 <-> x = y

items.name: DIST_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A), distance B (fstcart B x,fstcart B y) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) (x,y)

items.name: DIST_INCREASES_ONLINE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b d :e R :^: idx A, ~ d = vec A 0 -> distance A (a,b) < distance A (a,vector_add A b d) \/ distance A (a,b) < distance A (a,vector_sub A b d)

items.name: DIST_LADD
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (m + p)) = abs_SNo (n + - p)

items.name: DIST_LADD_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - m) = n

items.name: DIST_LE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) <= 0 <-> x = y

items.name: DIST_LE_CASES
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= p <-> m <= n + p /\ n <= m + p

items.name: DIST_LE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, distance A (x1,x2) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2) /\ distance B (y1,y2) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2)

items.name: DIST_LIFT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, distance 1 (lift x,lift y) = abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: DIST_LMUL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * abs_SNo (n + - p) = abs_SNo (m * n + - m * p)

items.name: DIST_LZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (0 + - n) = n

items.name: DIST_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, distance A (a,midpoint A (a,b)) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ (distance A (b,midpoint A (a,b)) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ (distance A (midpoint A (a,b),a) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ distance A (midpoint A (a,b),b) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2))

items.name: DIST_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, distance A (vector_mul A c x,vector_mul A c y) = abs_SNo c * distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_NZ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = y <-> 0 < distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_PASTECART_CANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall x x' :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y,pastecart A B x' y) = distance A (x,x')) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall y y' :e R :^: idx D, distance (idx_n (dimindex C + dimindex D)) (pastecart C D x y,pastecart C D x y') = distance D (y,y')

items.name: DIST_PASTECART_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2) <= distance A (x1,x2) + distance B (y1,y2)

items.name: DIST_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = y -> 0 < distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_RADD
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + p) + - (n + p)) = abs_SNo (m + - n)

items.name: DIST_RADD_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - (m + n)) = n

items.name: DIST_REAL
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance 1 (x,y) = abs_SNo (x 1 + - y 1)

items.name: DIST_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,x) = 0

items.name: DIST_RESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y -> distance N (vector_mul N a x,y) = distance N (x,vector_mul N a y)

items.name: DIST_RMUL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) * p = abs_SNo (m * p + - n * p)

items.name: DIST_RZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (n + - 0) = n

items.name: DIST_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), distance B (sndcart A B x,sndcart A B y) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (x,y)

items.name: DIST_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = distance A (y,x)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,z) <= distance N (x,y) + distance N (y,z)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLES_LE
items.statement: forall m n p q r s :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= r /\ abs_SNo (p + - q) <= s -> abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo (n + - q) + r + s

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x x' y y' :e R :^: idx A, distance A (vector_add A x y,vector_add A x' y') <= distance A (x,x') + distance A (y,y')

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ADD_HALF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x x' y y' :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,x') < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance N (y,y') < e0 :/: 2 -> distance N (vector_add N x y,vector_add N x' y') < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, distance A (y,z) <= distance A (x,y) + distance A (x,z)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,z) = distance A (x,y) + distance A (y,z) <-> vector_mul A (vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)) (vector_sub A y z) = vector_mul A (vector_norm A (vector_sub A y z)) (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_HALF_L
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x1 x2 y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x1,y) < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance A (x2,y) < e0 :/: 2 -> distance A (x1,x2) < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_HALF_R
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x1 x2 y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (y,x1) < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance A (y,x2) < e0 :/: 2 -> distance A (x1,x2) < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, distance A (x,z) + distance A (y,z) <= e0 -> distance A (x,y) <= e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, distance A (x,z) + distance A (y,z) < e0 -> distance A (x,y) < e0

items.name: DIVIDES_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ divides_nat n m <-> m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n -> (divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_EQ
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_IMP
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat (d * e0) n -> divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ (n = 0 -> e0 = 0) -> (divides_nat (div_nat n d) e0 <-> divides_nat n (d * e0))

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> div_nat n m * m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_SELF
items.statement: forall n d :e omega, divides_nat d n -> divides_nat (div_nat n d) n

items.name: DIVIDES_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> m <= n \/ n = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (n = 0 -> m = 0) -> m <= n

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_STRONG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> 1 <= m /\ m <= n \/ n = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_MOD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> mod_nat n m = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, divides_nat n 1 <-> n = 1

items.name: DIVISION
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n

items.name: DIVISION_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (n = 0 -> div_nat m n = 0 /\ mod_nat m n = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n)

items.name: DIVISION_SIMP
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, n * div_nat m n + mod_nat m n = m

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> forall q r :e omega, n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> P q r

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n) /\ P q r

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 -> q = 0 /\ r = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = q * n + r /\ r < n)

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> div_nat m n = q /\ mod_nat m n = r

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m n q1 r1 q2 r2 :e omega, m = q1 * n + r1 /\ r1 < n /\ (m = q2 * n + r2 /\ r2 < n) -> q1 = q2 /\ r1 = r2

items.name: DIV_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat 0 n = 0

items.name: DIV_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat n 1 = n

items.name: DIV_ADD
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a \/ divides_nat d b -> div_nat (a + b) d = div_nat a d + div_nat b d

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n

items.name: DIV_ADD_MOD
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (mod_nat (a + b) n = mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n <-> div_nat (a + b) n = div_nat a n + div_nat b n)

items.name: DIV_BY_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ divides_nat m n -> div_nat n (div_nat n m) = m

items.name: DIV_DIV
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, div_nat (div_nat m n) p = div_nat m (n * p)

items.name: DIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (div_nat m n = 0 <-> m < n)

items.name: DIV_EQ_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, b * c < (a + 1) * d /\ a * d < (c + 1) * b -> div_nat a b = div_nat c d

items.name: DIV_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n = m <-> m = 0 \/ n = 1

items.name: DIV_EXP
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m ^ n) (m ^ p) = if p <= n then m ^ minus_nat n p else if m = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: DIV_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n <= m

items.name: DIV_LE_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, ~ b = 0 /\ b * c < (a + 1) * d -> div_nat c d <= div_nat a b

items.name: DIV_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> div_nat m n = 0

items.name: DIV_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (div_nat m n) p = div_nat (mod_nat m (n * p)) n

items.name: DIV_MONO
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m <= n -> div_nat m p <= div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MONO2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ p = 0 /\ p <= m -> div_nat n m <= div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ p = 0 /\ m + p <= n -> div_nat m p < div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m * n) m = n

items.name: DIV_MULT2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m * n) (m * p) = div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (a * n + b) n = a + div_nat b n) /\ ((forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (n * a + b) n = a + div_nat b n) /\ ((forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (b + a * n) n = div_nat b n + a) /\ forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (b + n * a) n = div_nat b n + a))

items.name: DIV_MUL_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n * div_nat m n <= m

items.name: DIV_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat n n = 1

items.name: DIV_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> div_nat m n = q

items.name: DIV_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat n 0 = 0

items.name: DOT_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, dot 1 x y = x 1 * y 1

items.name: DOT_2
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 2, dot (idx_n 2) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2

items.name: DOT_3
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 3, dot (idx_n 3) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2 + x 3 * y 3

items.name: DOT_4
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 4, dot (idx_n 4) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2 + x 3 * y 3 + x 4 * y 4

items.name: DOT_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> dot N (basis N i) x = x i /\ dot N x (basis N i) = x i

items.name: DOT_BASIS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> dot N (basis N i) (basis N j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

items.name: DOT_BASIS_BASIS_UNEQUAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, ~ i = j -> dot A (basis A i) (basis A j) = 0

items.name: DOT_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y ^ 2 = dot N x x * dot N y y <-> collinear N {vec N 0,x,y}

items.name: DOT_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> dot M (dropout N M k x) (dropout N M k y) = dot N x y + - x k * y k

items.name: DOT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, dot N x x = 0 <-> x = vec N 0

items.name: DOT_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_add A x y) z = dot A x z + dot A y z

items.name: DOT_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_mul A c x) y = c * dot A x y

items.name: DOT_LMUL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (vector_matrix_mul M N x A) y = dot M x (matrix_vector_mul M N A y)

items.name: DOT_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_neg A x) y = - dot A x y

items.name: DOT_LSUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_sub A x y) z = dot A x z + - dot A y z

items.name: DOT_LSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, finite s -> dot A (vsum B A s f) y = finsum s (fun x:set => dot A (f x) y)

items.name: DOT_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vec A 0) x = 0

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = matrix_mul 1 N 1 (rowvector N x) (columnvector N y) 1 1

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_TRANSP_LMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N A (transp A N A0) x) y = dot A x (matrix_vector_mul A N A0 y)

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_TRANSP_RMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot A x (matrix_vector_mul A N (transp N A A0) y) = dot N (matrix_vector_mul N A A0 x) y

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x) (matrix_vector_mul N N B y) = matrix_mul 1 N 1 (rowvector N x) (matrix_mul N N 1 (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) B) (columnvector N y)) 1 1

items.name: DOT_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = ((vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) ^ 2 + - vector_norm A x ^ 2) + - vector_norm A y ^ 2) :/: 2

items.name: DOT_NORM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = ((vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm A y ^ 2) + - vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) ^ 2) :/: 2

items.name: DOT_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall x2 :e R :^: idx B, forall y1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, dot (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 x2) (pastecart A B y1 y2) = dot A x1 y1 + dot B x2 y2

items.name: DOT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= dot A x x

items.name: DOT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < dot A x x <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: DOT_PUSHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> dot N (pushin N R M k a x) (pushin N R M k b y) = dot M x y + a * b

items.name: DOT_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_add A y z) = dot A x y + dot A x z

items.name: DOT_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_mul A c y) = c * dot A x y

items.name: DOT_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_neg A y) = - dot A x y

items.name: DOT_ROWVECTOR_COLUMNVECTOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall v :e R :^: idx N, columnvector M (matrix_vector_mul M N A v) = matrix_mul M N 1 A (columnvector N v)

items.name: DOT_RSUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_sub A y z) = dot A x y + - dot A x z

items.name: DOT_RSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, finite s -> dot A x (vsum B A s f) = finsum s (fun y:set => dot A x (f y))

items.name: DOT_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vec A 0) = 0

items.name: DOT_SQUARE_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x x = vector_norm A x ^ 2

items.name: DOT_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = dot A y x

items.name: DOUBLE_HALF
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> 2 * div_nat n 2 = n) /\ forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> div_nat n 2 * 2 = n

items.name: DROPOUT_0
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, dropout N A k (vec N 0) = vec A 0

items.name: DROPOUT_ADD
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_add N x y) = vector_add A (dropout N A k x) (dropout N A k y)

items.name: DROPOUT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x k = y k /\ dropout N M k x = dropout N M k y))) -> x = y

items.name: DROPOUT_GALOIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> (y = dropout N M k x <-> exists t :e R, x = pushin N R M k t y)

items.name: DROPOUT_MUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_mul N c x) = vector_mul A c (dropout N A k x)

items.name: DROPOUT_PUSHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall t :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N -> dropout N M k (pushin N R M k t x) = x

items.name: DROPOUT_SUB
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_sub N x y) = vector_sub A (dropout N A k x) (dropout N A k y)

items.name: DROP_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_add 1 x y) = drop x + drop y

items.name: DROP_BASIS
items.statement: forall i :e omega, drop (basis 1 i) = if i = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: DROP_CMUL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R, drop (vector_mul 1 c x) = c * drop x

items.name: DROP_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = drop y <-> x = y

items.name: DROP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = 0 <-> x = vec 1 0

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, drop (indicator A s x) = if x :e s then 1 else 0

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_ABS_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (drop (indicator A s x)) <= 1

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, drop (indicator A s x) <= 1

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= drop (indicator A s x)

items.name: DROP_IN_IMAGE_DROP
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, drop x :e {drop x0 | x0 :e s} <-> x :e s

items.name: DROP_LAMBDA
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> drop (fun i :e idx 1 => x i) = x 1

items.name: DROP_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (midpoint 1 (x,y)) = (drop x + drop y) :/: 2

items.name: DROP_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_neg 1 x) = - drop x

items.name: DROP_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_sub 1 x y) = drop x + - drop y

items.name: DROP_VEC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, drop (vec 1 n) = n

items.name: DROP_VSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx 1) -> drop (vsum A 1 k x) = finsum k (fun x0:set => drop (x x0))

items.name: DROP_WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x <= drop y -> P x y) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, P x y

items.name: EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_nth l 0 = seq_hd l /\ seq_nth l (ordsucc n) = seq_nth (seq_tl l) n

items.name: ELEMENT_LE_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ a :e s -> a <= sup s

items.name: EL_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_nth (seq_append l m) k = if k < seq_len l then seq_nth l k else seq_nth m (minus_nat k (seq_len l))

items.name: EL_CONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_nth (seq_cons h t) n = if n = 0 then h else seq_nth t (minus_nat n 1)

items.name: EL_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, m < n -> seq_nth (seq_mk n s) m = s m

items.name: EL_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall n :e omega, forall l :e finseq A, n < seq_len l -> seq_nth (seq_map f l) n = f (seq_nth l n)

items.name: EL_MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, forall k :e omega, k < seq_len l /\ k < seq_len m -> seq_nth (seq_map2 f l m) k = f (seq_nth l k) (seq_nth m k)

items.name: EL_TL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_nth (seq_tl l) n = seq_nth l (n + 1)

items.name: EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e Empty <-> False

items.name: EMPTY_AS_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: Empty = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (1,0) seq_nil)

items.name: EMPTY_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, Empty :\: {x} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty :\: s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | False} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_NOT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ Empty = A

items.name: EMPTY_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n < m -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty c= s

items.name: EMPTY_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = Empty <-> s = Empty /\ t = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = Empty <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> t = Empty

items.name: ENDS_IN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx B, b :e closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx C, ~ a :e open_interval C (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx D, ~ b :e open_interval D (a,b)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, a :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R, b :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R, ~ a :e open_real_interval (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R, ~ b :e open_real_interval (a,b)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_UNIT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> vec A 0 :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (vec A 0,vec A 1) seq_nil) /\ (vec B 1 :e closed_interval B (seq_cons (vec B 0,vec B 1) seq_nil) /\ (~ vec C 0 :e open_interval C (vec C 0,vec C 1) /\ ~ vec D 1 :e open_interval D (vec D 0,vec D 1)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_UNIT_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: 0 :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) /\ 1 :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)

items.name: EPSILON_DELTA_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, finite {x :e A | Q x} /\ ((forall d e0 :e R, forall x :e A, Q x /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 < d) -> P d x -> P e0 x) /\ (forall x :e A, Q x -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ P d x)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, Q x -> P d x

items.name: EQ_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n = m + p <-> n = p

items.name: EQ_ADD_LCANCEL_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = m <-> n = 0

items.name: EQ_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + p = n + p <-> m = n

items.name: EQ_ADD_RCANCEL_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = n <-> m = 0

items.name: EQ_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists R0:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, R0 (x,y) -> x :e s /\ y :e t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 (x,y0) -> y0 = y) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ R0 (y0,y) -> y0 = x)

items.name: EQ_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, ((True <-> t) <-> t) /\ (((t <-> True) <-> t) /\ (((False <-> t) <-> ~ t) /\ ((t <-> False) <-> ~ t)))

items.name: EQ_C_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists R0:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 (x,y0) -> y0 = y) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ R0 (y0,y) -> y0 = x

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s :/\: s' = Empty /\ t :/\: t' = Empty -> (equip s t /\ equip s' t' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s' -> f x :e t' /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t' -> g y :e s' /\ f (g y) = y))))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_EXTEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ (equip (s' :\: s) (t' :\: t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)))) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e A, f' x :e B) /\ exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e B, g' x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s' -> f' x :e t' /\ g' (f' x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t' -> g' y :e s' /\ f' (g' y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f' x = f x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g' y = g y)))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ t' c= t -> (equip s' t' /\ equip (s :\: s') (t :\: t') <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ {g x | x :e t'} = s'))))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_SUBSETS_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (infinite s -> atleastp s' s /\ ~ equip s' s)) -> (equip s t /\ equip s' t' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ {g x | x :e t'} = s'))))

items.name: EQ_C_INVOLUTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e s) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s \/ x :e t -> f (f x) = x)) -> equip s t

items.name: EQ_DIVMOD
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, div_nat m p = div_nat n p /\ mod_nat m p = mod_nat n p <-> m = n

items.name: EQ_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, x ^ m = x ^ n <-> (x = 0 -> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)) /\ (~ x = 0 -> x = 1 \/ m = n)

items.name: EQ_EXT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, f x = g x) -> forall x :e A, f x = g x

items.name: EQ_IMP

items.name: EQ_IMP_LE
