items.name: NEUTRAL_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_REAL_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_REAL_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_VECTOR_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> neutral_of (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add N a b) = vec N 0

items.name: NONEMPTY_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = Empty

items.name: NONNEGATIVE_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ 0 <= x <-> exists n :e omega, x = n

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ x <= 0 <-> exists n :e omega, x = - n

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ x <= 0 <-> exists n :e omega, x + n = 0

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_IFF_SAME_DOT_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) y) = dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x) (matrix_vector_mul N N A y)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_IFF_SAME_NORM_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) = vector_norm N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> normal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_KERNEL_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x = vec N 0} = {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul N N A x = vec N 0}

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_KERNEL_TRANSP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x = vec N 0 <-> matrix_vector_mul N N A x = vec N 0)

items.name: NORM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_norm A (vec A 0) = 0

items.name: NORM_1
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, vector_norm 1 x = abs_SNo (drop x)

items.name: NORM_1_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, 0 <= drop x -> vector_norm 1 x = drop x

items.name: NORM_ADD_PYTHAGOREAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N a b -> vector_norm N (vector_add N a b) ^ 2 = vector_norm N a ^ 2 + vector_norm N b ^ 2

items.name: NORM_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (basis N k) = 1

items.name: NORM_BASIS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_norm A (basis A 1) = 1

items.name: NORM_BOUND_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, vector_norm N x <= e0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= e0

items.name: NORM_BOUND_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, vector_norm N x < e0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) < e0

items.name: NORM_BOUND_GENERALIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M x = 1 -> vector_norm N (f x) <= b) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x)

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y <= vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_ABS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) <= vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x \/ vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (- vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_DIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y :/: (vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y)) <= 1

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> collinear N {vec N 0,x,y}

items.name: NORM_COLUMN_LE_ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, vector_norm M (column M N i A) <= onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x)

items.name: NORM_CROSS_MULTIPLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N a x = vector_mul N b y /\ (0 < a /\ 0 < b) -> vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x = vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y

items.name: NORM_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x = vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x = dot B y y

items.name: NORM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_0_DOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 <-> dot A x x = 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_0_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 -> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 1 <-> dot A x x = 1

items.name: NORM_EQ_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) = abs_SNo (y i)) -> vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_EQ_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x = a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A), vector_norm B (fstcart B x) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) x

items.name: NORM_GE_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, a <= vector_norm N x <-> a <= 0 \/ a ^ 2 <= dot N x x

items.name: NORM_GT_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, a < vector_norm N x <-> a < 0 \/ a ^ 2 < dot N x x

items.name: NORM_INCREASES_ONLINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a d :e R :^: idx N, ~ d = vec N 0 -> vector_norm N a < vector_norm N (vector_add N a d) \/ vector_norm N a < vector_norm N (vector_sub N a d)

items.name: NORM_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x <= vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x <= dot B y y

items.name: NORM_LE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x <= 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_LE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= abs_SNo (y i)) -> vector_norm N x <= vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_LE_INFNORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= (if 0 <= dimindex N then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dimindex N) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dimindex N)) * infnorm N x

items.name: NORM_LE_L1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => abs_SNo (x i))

items.name: NORM_LE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm M x <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y) /\ vector_norm N y <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: NORM_LE_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x <= a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_LIFT
items.statement: forall x :e R, vector_norm 1 (lift x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: NORM_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x < vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x < dot B y y

items.name: NORM_LT_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x < a <-> 0 < a /\ dot N x x < a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_LT_SQUARE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x < a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x < a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_mul A a x) = abs_SNo a * vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_neg A x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) = if 0 <= vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2))

items.name: NORM_PASTECART_0
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x (vec B 0)) = vector_norm A x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx C, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex D + dimindex C)) (pastecart D C (vec D 0) y) = vector_norm C y

items.name: NORM_PASTECART_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) <= vector_norm A x + vector_norm B y

items.name: NORM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < vector_norm A x <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_POW_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x ^ 2 = dot A x x

items.name: NORM_REAL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, vector_norm 1 x = abs_SNo (x 1)

items.name: NORM_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), vector_norm B (sndcart A B x) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) x

items.name: NORM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) = vector_norm A (vector_sub A y x)

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) <= vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (vector_add N x y) = vector_norm N x + vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y <= e0 -> vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) <= e0

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y < e0 -> vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) < e0

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= vector_norm N y + vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)

items.name: NORM_VSUM_PYTHAGOREAN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k /\ (forall x y :e k, x <> y -> orthogonal N (u x) (u y)) -> vector_norm N (vsum A N k u) ^ 2 = finsum k (fun i:set => vector_norm N (u i) ^ 2)

items.name: NOT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_all P l <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall t:prop, ~ ~ t <-> t) /\ ((~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True))

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES_WEAK
items.statement: (~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True)

items.name: NOT_CONS_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, ~ seq_cons h t = seq_nil

items.name: NOT_DEF
items.statement: forall p:prop, ~ p <-> p -> False

items.name: NOT_EMPTY_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ Empty = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: NOT_EQUAL_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, ~ s = t <-> exists x :e A, x :e t <-> ~ x :e s

items.name: NOT_EVEN
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ even_nat n <-> odd_nat n

items.name: NOT_EX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_ex P l <-> seq_all (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (exists x :e A, P x) <-> forall x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (forall x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_IMP
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, ~ (t1 -> t2) <-> t1 /\ ~ t2

items.name: NOT_INSERT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ SetAdjoin s x = Empty

items.name: NOT_INT_REM_2
items.statement: (forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 0 <-> rem_int n 2 = 1) /\ forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 1 <-> rem_int n 2 = 0

items.name: NOT_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, ~ x :e Empty

items.name: NOT_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m <= n <-> n < m

items.name: NOT_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m < n <-> n <= m

items.name: NOT_ODD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ odd_nat n <-> even_nat n

items.name: NOT_PSUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= Empty /\ s <> Empty)

items.name: NOT_SUC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ ordsucc n = 0

items.name: NOT_UNIV_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (A c= s /\ A <> s)

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e omega) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: NSUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun n:set => 0) = 0

items.name: NSUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: NSUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: NSUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> finsum s f <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= div_nat b (finite_cardinality s))) -> finsum s f <= b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < div_nat b (finite_cardinality s))) -> finsum s f < b

items.name: NSUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f + finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finsum Empty f = 0) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e omega) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finsum (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finsum s f else f x + finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m + finsum {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> (forall m :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + f (ordsucc n) else finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i <= k} f + f (ordsucc k)

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | i < 0} f = 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i < k} f + f k

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + f n

items.name: NSUM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, P 0 /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: NSUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: NSUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun n:set => c) = finite_cardinality s * c

items.name: NSUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = minus_nat (n + 1) m * c

items.name: NSUM_DEGENERATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, ~ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: NSUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a + finsum (s :\: {a}) f = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 0) = if a :e s then b else 0

items.name: NSUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finsum (s :\: t) f = minus_nat (finsum s f) (finsum t f)

items.name: NSUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finsum s f = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finsum s f = 0 <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0)

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s g = finsum {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e omega) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = 0) -> finsum {i x | x :e s} d = finsum s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: NSUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum (s :\/: t) f + finsum (s :/\: t) f

items.name: NSUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => c * f x) = c * finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_MULTICOUNT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = k * finite_cardinality t

items.name: NSUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k j)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = finsum t k

items.name: NSUM_MUL_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e omega) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e A, b x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun i:set => a i * b i) <= finsum s a * finsum s b

items.name: NSUM_NSUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e omega) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum (t i) (x i)) = finsum (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: NSUM_NSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun x:set => finsum {y :e B | y :e t /\ R0 x y} (f x)) = finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: NSUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: NSUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: NSUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: NSUM_POS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s /\ finsum s f <= b -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b

items.name: NSUM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ 0 < f x) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_POS_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 < f i)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 0 else finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: NSUM_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, R0 0 0 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: NSUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: NSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else 0) = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else 0)

items.name: NSUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => f x * c) = finsum s f * c

items.name: NSUM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall x :e A, finsum {x} f = f x

items.name: NSUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: NSUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite u /\ (finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u :\: v -> f x = 0)) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite v /\ u c= v -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum v f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finsum {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} f = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum t (f i)) = finsum t (fun j:set => finsum s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: NSUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: NSUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: NSUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: NSUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (Union s) f = finsum s (fun t:set => finsum t f)

items.name: NSUM_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, finite u /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} c= s -> finsum s f = finsum A f

items.name: NULL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_len seq_nil = 0 <-> True) /\ (seq_len (seq_cons h t) = 0 <-> False)

items.name: NULLSPACE_INTER_ROWSPACE

items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :\/: {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p}

items.name: NUMSEG_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, atleastp (idx_n n) s <-> finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} = if m = 0 then {0} else Empty) /\ forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} = if m <= ordsucc n then SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (ordsucc n) else {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LE
items.statement: {i :e omega | i <= 0} = {0} /\ forall k :e omega, {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | i <= k} (ordsucc k)

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LT
items.statement: {i :e omega | i < 0} = Empty /\ forall k :e omega, {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | i < k} k

items.name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n + 1 -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat p 1} :\/: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, m <= p + 1 /\ p <= n -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} :\/: {i :e omega | p + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_DIMINDEX_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists i :e omega, i :e idx N

items.name: NUMSEG_EMPTY
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = Empty <-> n < m

items.name: NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {x :e omega | x <= n} = {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_LREC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} m = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {x :e omega | x < n} = if n = 0 then Empty else {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1}

items.name: NUMSEG_LT_DIMINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> {i :e omega | i < dimindex N} = {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat (dimindex N) 1}

items.name: NUMSEG_OFFSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} = {i + p | i :e {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}}

items.name: NUMSEG_REC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= ordsucc n -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (ordsucc n)

items.name: NUMSEG_RREC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} n = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_SING
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} = {n}
