items.name: NUM_CASES_BINARY
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, P n) <-> (forall n :e omega, P (2 * n)) /\ forall n :e omega, P (2 * n + 1)

items.name: NUM_COUNTABLE
items.statement: countable omega

items.name: NUM_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = gcd_int a b

items.name: NUM_LCM
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int a b = lcm_int a b

items.name: NUM_OF_INT
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 <= x <-> (if x :e omega then x else 0) = x

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x + y :e omega then x + y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) + if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x * y :e omega then x * y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) * if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_OF_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (if n :e omega then n else 0) = n

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 0 <= x -> (if x ^ n :e omega then x ^ n else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) ^ n

items.name: ODD
items.statement: (odd_nat 0 <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m + n) <-> ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: ODD_DOUBLE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc (2 * n))

items.name: ODD_EXISTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> exists m :e omega, n = ordsucc (2 * m)

items.name: ODD_EXP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m ^ n) <-> odd_nat m \/ n = 0

items.name: ODD_MOD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> mod_nat n 2 = 1

items.name: ODD_MOD_EVEN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> (odd_nat (mod_nat m n) <-> odd_nat m)

items.name: ODD_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m * n) <-> odd_nat m /\ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (minus_nat m n) <-> n < m /\ ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: OEP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A p -> exists t:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A t /\ (fld_on A t = fld_on A p /\ forall x y :e A, p x y -> t x y)

items.name: ONE_ONE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x1 x2 :e A, f x1 = f x2 -> x1 = x2)

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat n p -> n = 1 \/ n = p

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVIDES_OR_COPRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1

items.name: ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= onorm M N f * vector_norm M x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x) -> onorm M N f <= b

items.name: ONORM_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (adjoint N N f) = onorm N N f

items.name: ONORM_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, linear M N f -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = abs_SNo c * onorm M N f

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> linear C A f /\ linear B C g -> onorm B A (fun x:set => f (g x)) <= onorm C A f * onorm B C g

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ADJOINT_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (fun x:set => adjoint N N f (f x)) = onorm N N f ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ADJOINT_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (fun x:set => f (adjoint N N f x)) = onorm N N f ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, onorm M N (fun x:set => y) = vector_norm N y

items.name: ONORM_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_COVARIANCE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A)) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N f = sup (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {dot N (f x) y | y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm M x = 1 /\ vector_norm N y = 1})

items.name: ONORM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (onorm M N f = 0 <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = vec N 0)

items.name: ONORM_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> onorm N N (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: ONORM_ID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> onorm N N (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: ONORM_INVERSE_FUNCTION_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N M f /\ (linear M N g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f (g x) = x)) -> 1 <= onorm N M f * onorm M N g

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x)

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ_2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, dot N x (f y) <= b * vector_norm N x * vector_norm M y)

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ_2_ABS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, abs_SNo (dot N x (f y)) <= b * vector_norm N x * vector_norm M y)

items.name: ONORM_LE_MATRIX_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> abs_SNo (A i j) <= B) -> onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x) <= dimindex M * dimindex N * B

items.name: ONORM_LE_MATRIX_COMPONENT_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x) <= finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => finsum (idx N) (fun j:set => abs_SNo (A i j)))

items.name: ONORM_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) = onorm M N f

items.name: ONORM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> 0 <= onorm A B f

items.name: ONORM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> (0 < onorm A B f <-> ~ forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x = vec B 0)

items.name: ONORM_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ linear M N g -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) <= onorm M N f + onorm M N g

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ (linear A B g /\ onorm A B f + onorm A B g <= e0) -> onorm A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) <= e0

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ (linear A B g /\ onorm A B f + onorm A B g < e0) -> onorm A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) < e0

items.name: ONTO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, y = f x)

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A m l \/ inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall k l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A k l /\ inseg_on A k m -> (forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> l x x0) \/ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> m x x0) \/ exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ (a :e fld_on A m /\ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel l a x x0) /\ forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel m a x x0)))

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l c= fld_on A m) -> inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> (fld_on A l c= fld_on A m <-> inseg_on A l m)

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l = fld_on A m) -> forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0

items.name: ORDINAL_IMP_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> woset_on A l

items.name: ORDINAL_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (exists x :e A, ~ x :e fld_on A l) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => l x y \/ y = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l) /\ (x :e fld_on A l \/ x = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l)))

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall l :e Power A :^: A, P l -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e l x)) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ y :e l x)

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, ordinal_on A l -> x :e fld_on A l -> x :e fld_on A (fun a:set => fun b:set => exists l0:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l0 /\ l0 a b)

items.name: ORDINAL_UP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l) \/ exists m:set -> set -> prop, exists x :e A, ordinal_on A m /\ (x :e fld_on A m /\ ~ x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A (vec A 0) x /\ orthogonal A x (vec A 0)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_AND_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x y /\ collinear N {vec N 0,x,y} <-> x = vec N 0 \/ y = vec N 0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> (orthogonal N (basis N i) x <-> x i = 0)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> (orthogonal N (basis N i) (basis N j) <-> ~ i = j)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, exists b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b /\ (b c= span N v /\ (v c= span N b /\ (equip b (dim N v) /\ forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e b /\ (b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (independent N b /\ (equip b (dim N s) /\ span N b = s))))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D E F G H I J:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> F <> Empty -> G <> Empty -> H <> Empty -> I <> Empty -> J <> Empty -> (forall a :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A a (vec A 0)) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, orthogonal B a x -> orthogonal B a (vector_mul B c x)) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx E, orthogonal E a x -> orthogonal E a (vector_neg E x)) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx F, orthogonal F a x /\ orthogonal F a y -> orthogonal F a (vector_add F x y)) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx G, orthogonal G a x /\ orthogonal G a y -> orthogonal G a (vector_sub G x y)) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx C, orthogonal C (vec C 0) a) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx D, forall c :e R, orthogonal D x a -> orthogonal D (vector_mul D c x) a) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx H, orthogonal H x a -> orthogonal H (vector_neg H x) a) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx I, orthogonal I x a /\ orthogonal I y a -> orthogonal I (vector_add I x y) a) /\ forall a x y :e R :^: idx J, orthogonal J x a /\ orthogonal J y a -> orthogonal J (vector_sub J x y) a))))))))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_EXTENSION_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :/\: SetAdjoin s (vec N 0) = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_IMP_INDEPENDENT_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t -> orthogonal N a b) -> s :/\: t c= {vec N 0}

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0) -> (orthogonal N (f x) (f y) <-> orthogonal M x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A (vector_neg A x) y <-> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LVSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> orthogonal N (f x) y) -> orthogonal N (vsum A N s f) y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_mul N a x) y <-> a = 0 \/ orthogonal N x y) /\ forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x (vector_mul N a y) <-> a = 0 \/ orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_NULLSPACE_ROWSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0 /\ y :e span M (rows N M A) -> orthogonal M x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_PROJECTION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (vector_sub N (f x) (f y))) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (f y))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_PROJECTION_EQ_SELF_ADJOINT_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (vector_sub N (f x) (f y))) <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (f x) = f x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x x <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x (vector_neg A y) <-> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_RVSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> orthogonal N x (f y)) -> orthogonal N x (vsum A N s f)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SPANNINGSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N b = s)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, exists x0 :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, x0 0 :e span N s /\ (x0 1 :e {z :e R :^: idx N | forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, x1 :e span N s -> orthogonal N z x1} /\ x = vector_add N (x0 0) (x0 1)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, y 0 :e span N s /\ (y 1 :e {z :e R :^: idx N | forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, x1 :e span N s -> orthogonal N z x1} /\ x = vector_add N (y 0) (y 1)) -> y = x0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, exists y z :e R :^: idx N, y :e span N s /\ ((forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e span N s -> orthogonal N z w) /\ x = vector_add N y z)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y x' y' :e R :^: idx N, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t -> orthogonal N a b) /\ (x :e span N s /\ (x' :e span N s /\ (y :e span N t /\ (y' :e span N t /\ vector_add N x y = vector_add N x' y')))) -> x = x' /\ y = y'

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x y <-> orthogonal A y x

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_ORTHOGONAL_2D
items.statement: forall x y z :e R :^: idx_n 2, ~ x = vec (idx_n 2) 0 /\ (orthogonal (idx_n 2) x y /\ orthogonal (idx_n 2) x z) -> collinear (idx_n 2) {vec (idx_n 2) 0,y,z}

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, (forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> orthogonal A x y) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e span A s -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPANS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e span A s /\ y :e span A t -> orthogonal A x y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, (forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e span A s -> orthogonal A x y) <-> forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SUBSPACE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = vec N 0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SUBSPACE_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s c= span N t /\ span N s <> span N t -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = vec N 0 /\ (x :e span N t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e span N s -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTOR_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ y = vec N 0 /\ orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ x :e span N b) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N b (fun v:set => vector_mul N (dot N v x) v) = x

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ (x :e span N b \/ y :e span N b)) -> finsum b (fun v:set => dot N v x * dot N v y) = dot N x y

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ x :e span N b) -> finsum b (fun v:set => dot N v x ^ 2) = vector_norm N x ^ 2

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ (independent N b /\ (equip b (dim N s) /\ span N b = s))))

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x = 1) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :/\: s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t)))

items.name: OR_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True \/ t <-> True) /\ ((t \/ True <-> True) /\ ((False \/ t <-> t) /\ ((t \/ False <-> t) /\ (t \/ t <-> t))))

items.name: OR_DEF
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p \/ q <-> forall r:prop, (p -> r) -> (q -> r) -> r

items.name: OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q x

items.name: OUTL_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, OUTL A B (Inj0 x) = x

items.name: OUTR_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall y :e B, OUTR A B (Inj1 y) = y

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ 1 < p -> exists n :e omega, exists q r :e R, q :e int /\ (r :e int /\ (q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)))

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 < x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 <= x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n <= x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PAIR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A :*: B, (x 0,x 1) = x

items.name: PAIRED_ETA_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A :*: B, f (x 0,x 1) = f x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (x 0,(x 1 0,x 1 1)) = f x) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f x :e E) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f (x 0,(x 1 0,(x 1 1 0,x 1 1 1))) = f x)

items.name: PAIRED_EXT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y :e C) -> forall m:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, m x y :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y = m x y) <-> forall x :e A, forall x0 :e B, l x x0 = m x x0)

items.name: PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_pairwise r seq_nil <-> True) /\ (seq_pairwise r (seq_cons h t) <-> seq_all (r h) t /\ seq_pairwise r t)

items.name: PAIRWISE_AND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R' x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y /\ R' x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_append l m) <-> seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (seq_pairwise R0 m /\ forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ seq_mem y m -> R0 x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall c c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e c -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> forall x y :e Union c, x <> y -> R0 x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e Empty, x <> y -> r x y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e {f x | x :e s}, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ f x = f y -> r (f x) (f y))

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> P x y) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (P x y /\ ~ x = y)) -> Q x y) -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> Q x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMPLIES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ (seq_mem y l /\ R0 x y) -> R' x y) -> seq_pairwise R' l

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y /\ r y x) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall y :e A, y :e s -> (r x y <-> r y x)) -> ((forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_map f l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => R0 (f x) (f y)) l

items.name: PAIRWISE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) /\ t c= s -> forall x y :e t, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_ORTHOGONAL_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> finite s

items.name: PAIRWISE_ORTHOGONAL_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s -> independent N s

items.name: PAIRWISE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall x0 y :e {x}, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x0 y0 z :e A, R0 x0 y0 /\ R0 y0 z -> R0 x0 z) -> (seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons x (seq_cons y l)) <-> R0 x y /\ seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons y l))

items.name: PAIRWISE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s :\/: t, x <> y -> R0 x y) <-> (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ ((forall x y :e t, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s :\: t /\ y :e t :\: s -> R0 x y /\ R0 y x)

items.name: PAIR_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, (x,y) = (a,b) <-> x = a /\ y = b

items.name: PAIR_EXISTS_THM
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: PAIR_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, exists x :e A, exists y :e B, p = (x,y)

items.name: PASTECART_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx M, forall y1 :e R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx M, forall y2 :e R :^: idx N, vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x1 y1) (pastecart M N x2 y2) = pastecart M N (vector_add M x1 x2) (vector_add N y1 y2)

items.name: PASTECART_AS_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y = vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x (vec N 0)) (pastecart M N (vec M 0) y)

items.name: PASTECART_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, pastecart A B (vector_mul A c x1) (vector_mul B c y1) = vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) c (pastecart A B x1 y1)

items.name: PASTECART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> pastecart M N u v i = u i) /\ forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, dimindex M + 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M + dimindex N -> pastecart M N u v i = v (minus_nat i (dimindex M))

items.name: PASTECART_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), x = y <-> fstcart M x = fstcart M y /\ sndcart M N x = sndcart M N y

items.name: PASTECART_EQ_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, forall n :e omega, pastecart A B x y = vec (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) n <-> x = vec A n /\ y = vec B n

items.name: PASTECART_FST_SND
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), pastecart M N (fstcart M z) (sndcart M N z) = z

items.name: PASTECART_INJ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, forall w :e A :^: idx M, forall z :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y = pastecart M N w z <-> x = w /\ y = z

items.name: PASTECART_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: PASTECART_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N (vector_neg M x) (vector_neg N y) = vector_neg (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: PASTECART_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx M, forall y1 :e R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx M, forall y2 :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x1 y1) (pastecart M N x2 y2) = pastecart M N (vector_sub M x1 x2) (vector_sub N y1 y2)

items.name: PASTECART_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, pastecart A B (vec A n) (vec B n) = vec (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) n

items.name: PASTECART_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k c= C, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e C, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e C, y x0 :e R :^: idx B) -> finite k -> pastecart A B (vsum C A k x) (vsum C B k y) = vsum C (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) k (fun i:set => pastecart A B (x i) (y i))

items.name: PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: PCROSS_AS_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ u :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), {vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) u v | v :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), u :e {pastecart M N x (vec N 0) | x :e s} /\ v :e {pastecart M N (vec M 0) y | y :e t}}

items.name: PCROSS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Empty}) = Empty) /\ forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Empty, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

items.name: PCROSS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_INTER
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :/\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :/\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :/\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e g}, x :e Y} else if g = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g}), x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_MONO
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= \/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}

items.name: PCROSS_SING
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, (\/_ x0 :e {x}, {pastecart M N x0 y0 | y0 :e {y}}) = {pastecart M N x y}

items.name: PCROSS_UNION
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\/: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\/: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\/: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\/: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union f}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union g}) = Union (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g})

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ADD
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_CONST
items.statement: forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_FINITE_ROOTS
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall a :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> (finite {x :e R | p x = a} <-> ~ forall x :e R, p x = a)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_I
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ID
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P (fun x :e R => x) /\ ((forall c :e R, P (fun x :e R => c)) /\ ((forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x + q x)) /\ (forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x * q x)))) -> forall p :e R :^: R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x) -> P p

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_LMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c * p x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_MUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_NEG
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> (polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => - p x) <-> polynomial_function_R p)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_POW
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x ^ n)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_RMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUB
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + - q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R, forall y :e A, p x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x i)) -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => finsum s (p x))

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_o
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p (q x))

items.name: POSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: POSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: POSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l a x

items.name: POSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l x a

items.name: POSET_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: POSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, poset_on A l -> poset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: POSET_RESTRICTED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, poset_on (Power A) (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ x c= y))

items.name: POSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: POSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> poset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: POSET_num
items.statement: poset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: POWERSET_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> {s :e Power A | s c= Empty} = {Empty} /\ forall a :e A, forall t c= A, {s :e Power A | s c= SetAdjoin t a} = {s :e Power A | s c= t} :\/: {{x0 :e A | x0 :e SetAdjoin x a} | x :e {s :e Power A | s c= t}}

items.name: POW_2_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = x

items.name: POW_2_SQRT_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = abs_SNo x

items.name: PRE
items.statement: nat_pred 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, nat_pred (ordsucc n) = n

items.name: PRESERVES_NORM_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: PRESERVES_NORM_PRESERVES_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0) -> dot N (f x) (f y) = dot M x y

items.name: PRESEVES_NORM_PRESERVES_DIST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> forall m :e omega, n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0 -> P m

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> exists m :e omega, (n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0) /\ P m

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_EQ_NONDIVISIBLE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_nat p n

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e R) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall k c= K, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e K, x x :e A) -> forall x0 :e K, (if x0 :e k then f x0 ((fun x1 :e K => if x1 :e k then x x1 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: PROPERLY_DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (~ n = 0 /\ ~ m = n) -> 2 * m <= n

items.name: PROPERLY_EQ_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel l x x0 <-> strictly_rel l x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> S x y) -> forall x y :e A, properly_rel R0 x y -> properly_rel S x y

items.name: PROPERLY_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (properly_rel R0) x x0 <-> properly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (strictly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ ~ s = t

items.name: PSUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ exists a :e A, a :e t /\ ~ a :e s

items.name: PSUBSET_INSERT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s /\ SetAdjoin s x c= t

items.name: PSUBSET_IRREFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= s /\ s <> s)

items.name: PSUBSET_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ t c= u -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ (t c= u /\ t <> u) -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= Power A, (forall x y :e v, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (u c= v :\: {Empty} /\ u <> v :\: {Empty}) -> Union u c= Union v /\ Union u <> Union v

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, s c= A /\ s <> A <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s

items.name: PUSHIN_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> pushin N R M k (x k) (dropout N M k x) = x

items.name: P_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e P) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e P) -> hull A P s :e P

items.name: QOSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> fld_on A l = {x :e A | l x x}

items.name: QOSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: QOSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l a x

items.name: QOSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l x a

items.name: QOSET_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, qoset_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (fun x :e A :^: K => {y :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (i i) (y i)}) x) <-> s = Empty \/ qoset_on A l

items.name: QOSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: QOSET_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, qoset_on A l -> (l x x <-> x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: QOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: QOSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: QOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: QOSET_num
items.statement: qoset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: QUANTIFY_SURJECTION_HIGHER_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) -> (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e B, P x) <-> forall x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e B, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= B, Q s) <-> forall s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= B, Q s) <-> exists s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= Power B, Q s) <-> forall s c= Power A, Q {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= Power B, Q s) <-> exists s c= Power A, Q {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (forall g :e B :^: (R :^: idx 1), P g) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx 1 => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists g :e B :^: (R :^: idx 1), P g) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e R :^: idx 1 => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (forall g :e B :^: omega, P g) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> P (fun x :e omega => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists g :e B :^: omega, P g) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e omega => f (g x))) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall l :e finseq B, Q l) <-> forall l :e finseq A, Q (seq_map f l)) /\ (forall Q:set -> prop, (exists l :e finseq B, Q l) <-> exists l :e finseq A, Q (seq_map f l)))))))))))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, {x :e B | P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, {s :e Power B | Q s} = {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e {s :e Power A | Q {f x | x :e s}}}) /\ forall R0:set -> prop, {l :e finseq B | R0 l} = {seq_map f x | x :e {l :e finseq A | R0 (seq_map f l)}}))

items.name: QUANTIFY_SURJECTION_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) -> (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e B, P x) <-> forall x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e B, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= B, Q s) <-> forall s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ (forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= B, Q s) <-> exists s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}))) /\ forall P:set -> prop, {x :e B | P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}}

items.name: RANK_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> rank A B (mat B A 0) = 0

items.name: RANK_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A <= if dimindex M <= dimindex N then dimindex M else dimindex N

items.name: RANK_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, rank N M (matrix_cmul M N c A) = if c = 0 then 0 else rank N M A

items.name: RANK_DIM_IM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim N {matrix_vector_mul N M A x | x :e R :^: idx M}

items.name: RANK_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = 0 <-> A = mat N M 0

items.name: RANK_GRAM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> rank N N (mat N N 1) = dimindex N

items.name: RANK_INVERTIBLE_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible N M A -> rank P N (matrix_mul N M P A B) = rank P M B

items.name: RANK_INVERTIBLE_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible M P B -> rank P N (matrix_mul N M P A B) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N M (matrix_inv M N A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N N (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A)) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MUL_LE_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) <= rank N M A

items.name: RANK_MUL_LE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) <= rank P N B

items.name: RANK_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rank N M (matrix_neg M N A) = rank N M A

items.name: RANK_NULLSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0} = dimindex M

items.name: RANK_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim M (rows N M A)

items.name: RANK_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall U :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, invertible N M U -> rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N U) (matrix_mul N N M A U)) = rank N N A

items.name: RANK_SYLVESTER
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank N M A + rank P N B <= rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) + dimindex N

items.name: RANK_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N M (transp N M A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N (matrix_add N M A B) <= rank M N A + rank M N B

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational <-> exists p q :e omega, ~ q = 0 /\ abs_SNo x = p :/: q

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists r :e R, r :e rational /\ abs_SNo (r + - x) < e0

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_ABOVE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x < q /\ q < x + e0)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_BELOW
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x + - e0 < q /\ q < x)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists a b :e R, a :e rational /\ (b :e rational /\ (a < x /\ (x < b /\ abs_SNo (b + - a) < e0)))

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN_EQ
items.statement: forall a b :e R, (exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)) <-> a < b

items.name: RATIONAL_CLOSED
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, n :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, forall r :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ r :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational) /\ forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational))))))))

items.name: RATIONAL_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, recip_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R) -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> x i :e rational) -> finsum s x :e rational

items.name: RAT_LEMMA1
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, ~ y1 = 0 /\ ~ y2 = 0 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA2
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA3
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + - x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + - x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RDIV_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (div_nat b a < n <-> b < a * n)

items.name: REAL_ABS_0
items.statement: abs_SNo 0 = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_1
items.statement: abs_SNo 1 = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x + - d < y /\ y < x + d) <-> abs_SNo (y + - x) < d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN1
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x < z /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < z + - x -> y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN2
items.statement: forall x0 x y0 y :e R, x0 < y0 /\ (2 * abs_SNo (x + - x0) < y0 + - x0 /\ 2 * abs_SNo (y + - y0) < y0 + - x0) -> x < y

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < d -> y < x + d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall x k :e R, abs_SNo x <= k <-> - k <= x /\ x <= k

items.name: REAL_ABS_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, x = 0 \/ 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall x y h :e R, abs_SNo h < abs_SNo y + - abs_SNo x -> abs_SNo (x + h) < abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (distance N (x,y)) = distance N (x,y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x :/: y) = abs_SNo x :/: abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_INFNORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (infnorm A x) = infnorm A x

items.name: REAL_ABS_INF_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (inf s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_INTEGER_LEMMA
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ ~ x = 0 -> 1 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (recip_SNo x) = recip_SNo (abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, x <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (2 * abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT_POS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x * y) = abs_SNo x * abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (- x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (vector_norm A x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: REAL_ABS_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo n = n

items.name: REAL_ABS_NZ
items.statement: forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 <-> 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (x ^ n) = abs_SNo x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ABS_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: REAL_ABS_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < y -> 0 < x

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < - y -> x < 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = if 0 <= abs_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_STILLNZ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < abs_SNo y -> ~ x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) = abs_SNo (y + - x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y) <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_INFNORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (infnorm A x + - infnorm A y) <= infnorm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (vector_norm A x + - vector_norm A y) <= vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (sup s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + y) <= abs_SNo x + abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) <= z -> abs_SNo y <= z

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) < z -> abs_SNo y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, abs_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= n then abs_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (abs_SNo x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ADD2_SUB2
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, (a + b) + - (c + d) = (a + - c) + b + - d

items.name: REAL_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e R, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)

items.name: REAL_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x + y + z = (x + y) + z

items.name: REAL_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

items.name: REAL_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 + x = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_LINV
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x + x = 0

items.name: REAL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

items.name: REAL_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + 0 = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_RINV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + y) + - x = y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + y) = - y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x

items.name: REAL_ARCH
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> forall y :e R, exists n :e omega, y < n * x

items.name: REAL_ARCH_INV
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 <-> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (0 < recip_SNo n /\ recip_SNo n < e0)

items.name: REAL_ARCH_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < x -> exists n :e omega, y < x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < 2 ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW_INV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 < y /\ x < 1 -> exists n :e omega, x ^ n < y

items.name: REAL_ARCH_RDIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x c :e R, 0 <= x /\ (0 <= c /\ (forall m :e omega, 0 < m -> m * x <= c)) -> x = 0

items.name: REAL_ARCH_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x <= n

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LE
items.statement: forall x k :e R, - k <= x /\ x <= k <-> abs_SNo x <= k

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LT
items.statement: forall x k :e R, - k < x /\ x < k <-> abs_SNo x < k

items.name: REAL_CARD_INTSEG_INT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a :e int /\ b :e int -> finite_cardinality {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)} = if b < a then 0 else (b + - a) + 1

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a <= b -> closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_real_interval (a,b) :\/: {a,b}

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M') -> M <= M'

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE_SOMEPOS
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x /\ 0 <= x) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M') -> M <= M'

items.name: REAL_CONGRUENCE
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = b + n * q2) <-> (n = 0 -> a = b) /\ (~ n = 0 -> (a + - b) :/: n :e int)

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND2_LE
items.statement: forall b x y a u v :e R, x <= a /\ (y <= b /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> u * x + v * y <= u * a + v * b

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND2_LT
items.statement: forall b x y a u v :e R, x < a /\ (y < b /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> u * x + v * y < u * a + v * b

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUNDS_LT
items.statement: forall x y a b u v :e R, a < x /\ (x < b /\ (a < y /\ (y < b /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))))) -> a < u * x + v * y /\ u * x + v * y < b

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND_GE
items.statement: forall x y a u v :e R, a <= x /\ (a <= y /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> a <= u * x + v * y

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND_GT
items.statement: forall x y a u v :e R, a < x /\ (a < y /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> a < u * x + v * y

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND_LE
items.statement: forall x y a u v :e R, x <= a /\ (y <= a /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> u * x + v * y <= a

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall x y a u v :e R, x < a /\ (y < a /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> u * x + v * y < a

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_SUM_BOUND_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall d :e R, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R) -> forall b :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R) -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 <= x i) /\ (finsum s x = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> abs_SNo (a i + - b) <= d)) -> abs_SNo (finsum s (fun i:set => a i * x i) + - b) <= d

items.name: REAL_CONVEX_SUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall d :e R, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R) -> forall b :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R) -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 <= x i) /\ (finsum s x = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> abs_SNo (a i + - b) < d)) -> abs_SNo (finsum s (fun i:set => a i * x i) + - b) < d

items.name: REAL_DIFFSQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + y) * (x + - y) = x * x + - y * y

items.name: REAL_DIV_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :/: 1 = x

items.name: REAL_DIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: y = 0 <-> x = 0 \/ y = 0

items.name: REAL_DIV_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: y = 1 <-> x = y /\ (~ x = 0 /\ ~ y = 0)

items.name: REAL_DIV_LMUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, ~ y = 0 -> y * x :/: y = x

items.name: REAL_DIV_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, ~ x = 0 -> x ^ m :/: x ^ n = if n <= m then x ^ minus_nat m n else recip_SNo (x ^ minus_nat n m)

items.name: REAL_DIV_POW2_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, ~ x = 0 -> x ^ m :/: x ^ n = if n < m then x ^ minus_nat m n else recip_SNo (x ^ minus_nat n m)

items.name: REAL_DIV_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 -> x :/: x = 1

items.name: REAL_DIV_RMUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, ~ y = 0 -> x :/: y * y = x

items.name: REAL_DIV_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> x :/: (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)
