items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= x /\ (0 <= y /\ x <= (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y))) -> x ^ 2 <= y

items.name: REAL_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = x :/: abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_SGNS_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> (x = 0 <-> y = 0) /\ ((0 < x <-> 0 < y) /\ (x < 0 <-> y < 0))

items.name: REAL_SGNS_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> (x = 0 -> y = 0) /\ ((0 < x -> 0 < y) /\ (x < 0 -> y < 0))

items.name: REAL_SGN_0
items.statement: (if 0 < 0 then 1 else if 0 < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * abs_SNo x = x

items.name: REAL_SGN_ABS_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * x = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_SGN_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 \/ ((if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 1 \/ (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - 1)

items.name: REAL_SGN_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < x :/: y then 1 else if x :/: y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) :/: if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_EQ
items.statement: (forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 <-> x = 0) /\ ((forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 1 <-> 0 < x) /\ forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - 1 <-> x < 0)

items.name: REAL_SGN_EQ_INEQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> x = y \/ abs_SNo (x + - y) < if abs_SNo x <= abs_SNo y then abs_SNo y else abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_SGN_INEQS
items.statement: (forall x :e R, 0 <= (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 <= x) /\ ((forall x :e R, 0 < (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 < x) /\ ((forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <= 0 <-> x <= 0) /\ ((forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 <-> x < 0) /\ ((forall x :e R, 0 = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 = x) /\ ((forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <= 0 <-> x <= 0) /\ ((forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 <-> x < 0) /\ ((forall x :e R, 0 <= (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 <= x) /\ ((forall x :e R, 0 < (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 < x) /\ forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 <-> x = 0))))))))

items.name: REAL_SGN_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < recip_SNo x then 1 else if recip_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < x * y then 1 else if x * y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < - x then 1 else if - x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 < x ^ n then 1 else if x ^ n < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ n

items.name: REAL_SGN_POW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x ^ 2 then 1 else if x ^ 2 < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_REAL_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0 then 1 else if (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) then 1 else if (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_SGN_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 < if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)) then 1 else if (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 <= n then (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ n else recip_SNo ((if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: (1 + abs_SNo x) = y :/: (1 + abs_SNo y) <-> x = y

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_GALOIS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: (1 + abs_SNo x) = y <-> abs_SNo y < 1 /\ y :/: (1 + - abs_SNo y) = x

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_GROW
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x < 1 -> (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x)) :/: (1 + abs_SNo (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x))) = x

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_GROW_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x)) :/: (1 + abs_SNo (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x))) = x <-> abs_SNo x < 1

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_LE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: (1 + abs_SNo x) <= y :/: (1 + abs_SNo y) <-> x <= y

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: (1 + abs_SNo x) < y :/: (1 + abs_SNo y) <-> x < y

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_RANGE
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (x :/: (1 + abs_SNo x)) < 1

items.name: REAL_SOS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 0 <-> x = 0 /\ y = 0

items.name: REAL_SQRT_POW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_SUB_0
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - y = 0 <-> x = y

items.name: REAL_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: REAL_SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + - y) + y = x

items.name: REAL_SUB_ADD2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, y + x + - y = x

items.name: REAL_SUB_INV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, ~ x = 0 /\ ~ y = 0 -> recip_SNo x + - recip_SNo y = (y + - x) :/: (x * y)

items.name: REAL_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x * (y + - z) = x * y + - x * z

items.name: REAL_SUB_LE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= x + - y <-> y <= x

items.name: REAL_SUB_LNEG
items.statement: forall x y :e R, - x + - y = - (x + y)

items.name: REAL_SUB_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 < x + - y <-> y < x

items.name: REAL_SUB_LZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 + - x = - x

items.name: REAL_SUB_NEG2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, - x + - - y = y + - x

items.name: REAL_SUB_POLYFUN
items.statement: forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R) -> forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * x ^ i) + - finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ i) = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | j + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ minus_nat (minus_nat i j) 1) * x ^ j)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POLYFUN_ALT
items.statement: forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R) -> forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * x ^ i) + - finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ i) = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat (minus_nat n j) 1} (fun k:set => a (j + k + 1) * y ^ k) * x ^ j)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - y ^ n = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i * y ^ minus_nat (minus_nat n 1) i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW_L1
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> 1 + - x ^ n = (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW_R1
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - 1 = (x + - 1) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + - y) * z = x * z + - y * z

items.name: REAL_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0

items.name: REAL_SUB_RNEG
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - - y = x + y

items.name: REAL_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - 0 = x

items.name: REAL_SUB_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + - y) + - x = - y

items.name: REAL_SUB_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + - y) = y

items.name: REAL_SUB_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R, (a + - b) + b + - c = a + - c

items.name: REAL_SUP_ASCLOSE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l e0 :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo (x + - l) <= e0) -> abs_SNo (sup s + - l) <= e0

items.name: REAL_SUP_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a b :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x /\ x <= b) -> a <= sup s /\ sup s <= b

items.name: REAL_SUP_EQ_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists B :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= B) -> (sup s = inf s <-> exists a :e R, s = {a})

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> sup s <= b

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall y :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> (sup s <= y <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= y)

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s <= a <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= a)

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (s c= t /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= b)) -> sup s <= sup t

items.name: REAL_SUP_LT_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s < a <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x < a)

items.name: REAL_SUP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ (forall b' :e R, b' < b -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ b' < x) -> sup s = b

items.name: REAL_TRUNCATE
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n r :e R, n :e int /\ (0 <= r /\ (r < 1 /\ x = n + r))

items.name: REAL_TRUNCATE_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> exists n :e omega, exists r :e R, 0 <= r /\ (r < 1 /\ x = n + r)

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e R, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R, x <= y -> P x y) -> forall x y :e R, P x y

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LE_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e R, P x y z -> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x <= y /\ y <= z -> P x y z) -> forall x y z :e R, P x y z

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LT
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e R, P x x) /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R, x < y -> P x y)) -> forall x y :e R, P x y

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 0 then x ^ 0 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 0))) = 1

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 1 then x ^ 1 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 1))) = x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 2 then x ^ 2 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 2))) = x * x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ADD
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, ~ x = 0 -> (if 0 <= m + n then x ^ (m + n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- (m + n)))) = (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) * if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (x :/: y) ^ n else recip_SNo ((x :/: y) ^ (- n))) = (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) :/: if 0 <= n then y ^ n else recip_SNo (y ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = 0 <-> x = 0 /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then recip_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (recip_SNo x ^ (- n))) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, 0 <= x -> 0 <= if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, 0 < x -> 0 < if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_MINUS1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= - 1 then x ^ (- 1) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - 1))) = recip_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (x * y) ^ n else recip_SNo ((x * y) ^ (- n))) = (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) * if 0 <= n then y ^ n else recip_SNo (y ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= - n then x ^ (- n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - n))) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_NUM
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then 1 ^ n else recip_SNo (1 ^ (- n))) = 1

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_POW
items.statement: (forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = x ^ n) /\ forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= - n then x ^ (- n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - n))) = recip_SNo (x ^ n)

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_SUB
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, ~ x = 0 -> (if 0 <= m + - n then x ^ (m + - n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- (m + - n)))) = (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) :/: if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then 0 ^ n else recip_SNo (0 ^ (- n))) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) ^ n else recip_SNo ((if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= m * n then x ^ (m * n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m * n))

items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall a b :e A, (forall x y z :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (R0 a b /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> exists z :e A, R0 x z /\ R0 z y)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) /\ (f 0 = a /\ (f 1 = b /\ forall x y :e R, x :e (\/_ k :e omega, {k :/: 2 ^ n | n :e omega, k <= 2 ^ n}) /\ (y :e (\/_ k :e omega, {k :/: 2 ^ n | n :e omega, k <= 2 ^ n}) /\ x < y) -> R0 (f x) (f y)))

items.name: REFLECT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {vector_neg N x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_neg N b,vector_neg N a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {vector_neg N x | x :e open_interval N (a,b)} = open_interval N (vector_neg N b,vector_neg N a)

items.name: REFLECT_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, {- x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (- b,- a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R, {- x | x :e open_real_interval (a,b)} = open_real_interval (- b,- a)

items.name: REFL_CLAUSE

items.name: RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A P u = {u :/\: s | s :e Power A, s :e P}

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_COMPL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s c= u -> (u :\: s :e relative_to A P u <-> s :e relative_to A {c :e Power A | A :\: c :e P} u)

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, t :e relative_to A P s -> t c= s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s :e P -> u :/\: s :e relative_to A P u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall c d c= A, c :e P /\ d :e P -> c :/\: d :e P) -> forall c d c= A, c :e relative_to A P s /\ d :e relative_to A P s -> c :/\: d :e relative_to A P s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P Q c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e P -> s0 :e Q) -> forall u c= A, s :e relative_to A P u -> s :e relative_to A Q u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, relative_to A (relative_to A P s) t = relative_to A P (s :/\: t)

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s :e P -> s :e relative_to A P t

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s c= u /\ s :e P -> s :e relative_to A P u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall u s t c= A, s :e relative_to A P u /\ (s c= t /\ t c= u) -> s :e relative_to A P t

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall c d c= A, c :e P /\ d :e P -> c :\/: d :e P) -> forall c d c= A, c :e relative_to A P s /\ d :e relative_to A P s -> c :\/: d :e relative_to A P s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :e relative_to A P A <-> s :e P

items.name: REPLICATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, seq_replicate 0 x = seq_nil /\ seq_replicate (ordsucc n) x = seq_cons x (seq_replicate n x)

items.name: REST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)} = s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)}

items.name: RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) :e t then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if f x :e t then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, (if x :e s then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_DEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x

items.name: RESTRICTION_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = y

items.name: RESTRICTION_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_FIXPOINT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x) <-> f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x0 x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: RESTRICTION_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e A) -> ((fun x :e K => if x :e k then f x else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i)

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (fun x :e A => if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x0 x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: RESTRICTION_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e t then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNDEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = g x) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> g x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, f x = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e A then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x

items.name: REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_rev (seq_cons x l) = seq_append (seq_rev l) (seq_cons x seq_nil)

items.name: REVERSE_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_append l m) = seq_append (seq_rev m) (seq_rev l)

items.name: REVERSE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev l = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: REVERSE_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_rev l) = l

items.name: RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, (m + n) * p = m * p + n * p

items.name: RIGHT_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P /\ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_AND_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P /\ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P /\ Q x) <-> P /\ exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P \/ Q x) <-> P \/ forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_IMP_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P -> (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P -> Q x

items.name: RIGHT_IMP_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P -> (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P -> Q x

items.name: RIGHT_INVERSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) -> linear N N g

items.name: RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) B = mat N N 1) <-> exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1

items.name: RIGHT_OR_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, (p \/ q) /\ r <-> p /\ r \/ q /\ r

items.name: RIGHT_OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P \/ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_OR_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P \/ (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P \/ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_SUB_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat m n * p = minus_nat (m * p) (n * p)

items.name: ROWS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, ~ rows M N A = Empty

items.name: ROWS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rows N M (transp M N A) = columns M N A

items.name: ROW_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, row N N i (mat N N 0) = vec N 0

items.name: ROW_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> row M P i (matrix_mul M N P A B) = matrix_vector_mul P N (transp N P B) (row M N i A)

items.name: ROW_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> row N M i (transp M N A) = column M N i A

items.name: SAME_NORM_SAME_DOT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (linear M P g /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm P (g x0))) -> dot N (f x) (f y) = dot P (g x) (g y)

items.name: SELECT_AX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall x :e A, P x -> P (choose_in A P)

items.name: SELECT_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, choose_in A (fun y:set => y = x) = x

items.name: SELECT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, P y <-> y = x) -> choose_in A P = x

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (linear N N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N g x = g x))) -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = f (g x)) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = g (f x))

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, linear N N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (f v = vector_mul N a v /\ (f w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b))) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: SEQ_MONO_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m :e omega, forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, d x :e R) -> forall e0:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, e0 x :e R) -> (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> d n < e0 n) /\ (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> e0 n <= e0 m) -> forall n :e omega, m <= n -> d n < e0 m

items.name: SETSPEC
items.error: internal constant SETSPEC (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: SET_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, s x <-> x :e Empty) \/ exists x :e A, exists t c= A, (forall x0 :e A, s x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin t x) /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_set (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_set l1 :\/: seq_set l2

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_set l = Empty <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_set (seq_map f l) = {f x | x :e seq_set l}

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> seq_set (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) = s

items.name: SET_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, {p :e A :*: B | P p} = \/_ a :e A, {(a,b) | b :e B, P (a,b)}

items.name: SET_PROVE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall a :e A, forall s c= A, ~ a :e s -> P (SetAdjoin s a)) -> forall s c= A, P s

items.name: SET_RECURSION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, g x :e B) /\ (g Empty = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> g (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e s then g s else f x (g s))

items.name: SIMPLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e A, x :e s} = {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SIMPLE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P:set -> prop, {f x | x :e A, P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P x}}

items.name: SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, s = {x}) <-> exists x :e A, s = {x}

items.name: SING_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, s = {x}) <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> y = x

items.name: SING_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall a :e A, {x :e A | x = a} = {a}) /\ forall a :e A, {x :e A | a = x} = {a}

items.name: SING_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, {x} c= s <-> x :e s

items.name: SKOLEM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) <-> exists y:set -> set, (forall x :e A, y x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x (y x)

items.name: SKOLEM_THM_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> exists y :e B, R0 x y) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x -> R0 x (f x)

items.name: SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, y = y

items.name: SNDCART_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), sndcart M N (vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x y) = vector_add N (sndcart M N x) (sndcart M N y)

items.name: SNDCART_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall c :e R, sndcart M N (vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) c x) = vector_mul N c (sndcart M N x)

items.name: SNDCART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> sndcart M N x i = x (i + dimindex M)

items.name: SNDCART_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), vector_neg N (sndcart M N x) = sndcart M N (vector_neg (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x)

items.name: SNDCART_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, sndcart M N (pastecart M N x y) = y

items.name: SNDCART_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), sndcart M N (vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x y) = vector_sub N (sndcart M N x) (sndcart M N y)

items.name: SNDCART_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, sndcart A B (vec (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) n) = vec B n

items.name: SNDCART_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k c= C, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e C, x x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) -> finite k -> sndcart A B (vsum C (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) k x) = vsum C B k (fun i:set => sndcart A B (x i))

items.name: SND_DEF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, p 1 = choose_in B (fun y:set => exists x :e A, p = (x,y))

items.name: SPANNING_SUBSET_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (independent N s /\ s c= span N t) -> s = t

items.name: SPANNING_SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, R :^: idx M c= span M s /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> R :^: idx N c= span N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SPANS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b v c= R :^: idx A, linear A B f /\ v c= span A b -> {f x | x :e v} c= span B {f x | x :e b}

items.name: SPAN_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, vec A 0 :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, span A {a,b} = \/_ u :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_mul A v b) | v :e R, u :e R /\ v :e R}

items.name: SPAN_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, span A {a,b,c} = \/_ u :e R, \/_ v :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_add A (vector_mul A v b) (vector_mul A w c)) | w :e R, u :e R /\ (v :e R /\ w :e R)}

items.name: SPAN_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s /\ y :e span A s -> vector_add A x y :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> (vector_add A x y :e span A s <-> y :e span A s)

items.name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ a :e span N s -> exists k :e R, vector_sub N a (vector_mul N k b) :e span N (s :\: {b})

items.name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e span N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> exists k :e R, vector_sub N x (vector_mul N k a) :e span N s

items.name: SPAN_CARD_GE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, v c= span N b /\ finite b -> dim N v <= finite_cardinality b

items.name: SPAN_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s0 c= R :^: idx A, a :e s0 -> a :e span A s0) /\ (vec B 0 :e span B s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx D, forall s0 c= R :^: idx D, x :e span D s0 /\ y :e span D s0 -> vector_add D x y :e span D s0) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall c :e R, forall s0 c= R :^: idx C, x :e span C s0 -> vector_mul C c x :e span C s0))

items.name: SPAN_COLUMNSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, span N (columns N M A) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = y}

items.name: SPAN_DELETE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, span N (s :\: {vec N 0}) = span N s

items.name: SPAN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> span A Empty = {vec A 0}

items.name: SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s = span N t <-> s c= span N t /\ t c= span N s

items.name: SPAN_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, span A s = span A t -> dim A s = dim A t

items.name: SPAN_EQ_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, span N (SetAdjoin s x) = span N s <-> x :e span N s

items.name: SPAN_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A s = s <-> subspace A s

items.name: SPAN_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, span N p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y))}

items.name: SPAN_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> span N s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y}

items.name: SPAN_IMAGE_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> ~ c x = 0) -> span N {vector_mul N (c x) x | x :e s} = span N s

items.name: SPAN_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, s c= span A s

items.name: SPAN_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s h c= R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> x :e h) /\ subspace A h -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> x :e h

items.name: SPAN_INDUCT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall h:set -> prop, h (vec N 0) /\ (forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ h y -> h (vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) y)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s -> h x

items.name: SPAN_INSERT_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A (SetAdjoin s (vec A 0)) = span A s

items.name: SPAN_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> span N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e span M s}

items.name: SPAN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t -> span A s c= span A t

items.name: SPAN_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> vector_mul A c x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ c = 0 -> (vector_mul N c x :e span N s <-> x :e span N s)

items.name: SPAN_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> vector_neg A x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x :e span A s <-> x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_NOT_UNIV_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = R :^: idx N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s -> dot N a x = 0

items.name: SPAN_NOT_UNIV_SUBSET_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = R :^: idx N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ span N s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: SPAN_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> span N s = s

items.name: SPAN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (vec M 0 :e s \/ vec N 0 :e t)) -> span (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e span M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_PCROSS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, span (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= \/_ x :e span M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, span A {a} = {vector_mul A u a | u :e R, u :e R}

items.name: SPAN_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A (span A s) = span A s

items.name: SPAN_SPECIAL_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, span N (SetAdjoin s (vector_mul N a x)) = if a = 0 then span N s else span N (SetAdjoin s x)

items.name: SPAN_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> span N {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = R :^: idx N

items.name: SPAN_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s /\ y :e span A s -> vector_sub A x y :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ subspace N t -> span N s c= t

items.name: SPAN_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall b s c= R :^: idx A, b c= s /\ (s c= span A b /\ subspace A s) -> span A b = s

items.name: SPAN_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ vec N 0 :e s :\/: t) -> span N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N (SetAdjoin s x) -> y :e span N s

items.name: SPAN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N (s :\/: t) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, span A s :\/: span A t c= span A (s :\/: t)

items.name: SPAN_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> span N (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: SPAN_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e span B s) -> vsum A B t f :e span B s

items.name: SPECIAL_HYPERPLANE_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = 0} = span N {basis N x | x :e idx N :\: {k}}

items.name: SQNORM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) ^ 2 = vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2

items.name: SQRT_0
items.statement: (if 0 <= 0 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg 0 else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 0)) = 0

items.name: SQRT_1
items.statement: (if 0 <= 1 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg 1 else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 1)) = 1

items.name: SQRT_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x :/: y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x :/: y) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x :/: y)) = (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) :/: if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: SQRT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = 1 <-> x = 1

items.name: SQRT_EVEN_POW2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> (if 0 <= 2 ^ n then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (2 ^ n) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 2 ^ n)) = 2 ^ div_nat n 2

items.name: SQRT_INJ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x = y

items.name: SQRT_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= recip_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (recip_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- recip_SNo x)) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x))

items.name: SQRT_LE_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <-> 0 <= x

items.name: SQRT_LT_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <-> 0 < x

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x <= y -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <= if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <= (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x <= y

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x < y -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x < y

items.name: SQRT_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x * y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x * y) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x * y)) = (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) * if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= - x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- - x)) = - if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: SQRT_POW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= y /\ y ^ 2 = x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE_GEN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ y ^ 2 = abs_SNo x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y

items.name: SQRT_WORKS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x

items.name: SQRT_WORKS_GEN
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) then 1 else if (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = abs_SNo x

items.name: STRICTLY_DECREASING_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x < y) -> f y < f x) <-> (forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x <= y) -> f y <= f x) /\ forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: STRICTLY_EQ_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel l x x0 <-> properly_rel l x x0

items.name: STRICTLY_IMP_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, qoset_on A l /\ strictly_rel l x y -> properly_rel l x y

items.name: STRICTLY_INCREASING_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x < y) -> f x < f y) <-> (forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x <= y) -> f x <= f y) /\ forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: STRICTLY_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel (properly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: STRICTLY_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel (strictly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: SUB
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, minus_nat m 0 = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m (ordsucc n) = nat_pred (minus_nat m n)

items.name: SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s -> matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) = s) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBMATROID_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) <-> matroid_span A m (matroid_set A m :/\: s) x) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBMATROID_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, submatroid A m (matroid_set A m) = m

items.name: SUBMATROID_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> submatroid A m {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} = submatroid A m s

items.name: SUBMATROID_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, x :e matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) <-> matroid_span A m s x) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_DIAGONALIZATION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> exists k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> k m < k n) /\ P i (fun x :e omega => r (k x)))) /\ (forall i :e omega, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> forall k1:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k1 x :e omega) -> forall k2:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k2 x :e omega) -> forall N :e omega, P i (fun x :e omega => r (k1 x)) /\ (forall j :e omega, N <= j -> exists j' :e omega, j <= j' /\ k2 j = k1 j') -> P i (fun x :e omega => r (k2 x))) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> exists k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> k m < k n) /\ forall i :e omega, P i (fun x :e omega => r (k x)))

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_IMP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) -> forall m n :e omega, r m = r n <-> m = n

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_STEPWISE
items.statement: forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) <-> forall n :e omega, r n < r (ordsucc n))

items.name: SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> x :e t

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s -> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s <-> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ s c= t -> (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t <-> s = t)

items.name: SUBSET_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} c= {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i

items.name: SUBSET_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, s :*: t c= s' :*: t' <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ s c= s' /\ t c= t')

items.name: SUBSET_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, s c= t :\: {x} <-> ~ x :e s /\ s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\: t c= s

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall u c= K :*: A, u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, u = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i c= s i

items.name: SUBSET_DROP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, {drop x | x :e s} c= {drop x | x :e t} <-> s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: SUBSET_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, t :e P -> (hull A P s c= t <-> s c= t)

items.name: SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s c= {f x | x :e t} <-> exists u c= A, u c= t /\ s = {f x | x :e u}

items.name: SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s c= {f x | x :e t} <-> exists u c= A, u c= t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e u /\ y :e u -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ s = {f x | x :e u})

items.name: SUBSET_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ x :e s -> forall t c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t x <-> s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_INSERT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t x <-> s :\: {x} c= t

items.name: SUBSET_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t :/\: u <-> s c= t /\ s c= u

items.name: SUBSET_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s c= {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} <-> forall t c= A, t :e f -> s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c d a b :e R :^: idx N, (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> c i <= d i) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i)) /\ ((closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval N (a,b) <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> c i <= d i) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < c i /\ d i < b i)) /\ ((open_interval N (c,d) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> c i < d i) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i)) /\ (open_interval N (c,d) c= open_interval N (a,b) <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> c i < d i) -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i)))

items.name: SUBSET_INTERVAL_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a c d b :e R :^: idx N, ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i) -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < c i /\ d i < b i) -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval N (a,b)) /\ (((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i) -> open_interval N (c,d) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ d i <= b i) -> open_interval N (c,d) c= open_interval N (a,b))))

items.name: SUBSET_INTER_ABSORPTION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> s :/\: t = s

items.name: SUBSET_LE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= span N t -> dim N s <= dim N t

items.name: SUBSET_LIFT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall s t c= R, {lift x | x :e s} c= {lift x | x :e t} <-> s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_MATROID_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} <-> s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})

items.name: SUBSET_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} c= {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} <-> n < m \/ p <= m /\ n <= q

items.name: SUBSET_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ s c= s' /\ t c= t')

items.name: SUBSET_PRED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q c= A, P c= Q <-> forall x :e A, x :e P -> x :e Q

items.name: SUBSET_PSUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ t <> u) -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: SUBSET_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= closed_real_interval (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> b < a \/ c <= a /\ (a <= b /\ b <= d)) /\ ((closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= open_real_interval (c,d) <-> b < a \/ c < a /\ (a <= b /\ b < d)) /\ ((open_real_interval (a,b) c= closed_real_interval (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> b <= a \/ c <= a /\ (a < b /\ b <= d)) /\ (open_real_interval (a,b) c= open_real_interval (c,d) <-> b <= a \/ c <= a /\ (a < b /\ b <= d))))

items.name: SUBSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= s

items.name: SUBSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} c= s

items.name: SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ t c= u -> s c= u

items.name: SUBSET_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s t c= A, s c= s :\/: t) /\ forall s t c= A, s c= t :\/: s

items.name: SUBSET_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f g c= Power A, f c= g -> Union f c= Union g

items.name: SUBSET_UNION_ABSORPTION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> s :\/: t = t

items.name: SUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= A

items.name: SUBSPACE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s -> vec A 0 :e s

items.name: SUBSPACE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> vector_add A x y :e s

items.name: SUBSPACE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ dim N s = n

items.name: SUBSPACE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: SUBSPACE_IMP_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: SUBSPACE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ subspace A t -> subspace A (s :/\: t)

items.name: SUBSPACE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> subspace A s) -> subspace A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: SUBSPACE_ISOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim M s = dim N t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N f /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: SUBSPACE_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> subspace A {x :e R :^: idx A | f x = vec B 0}

items.name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_FIXED_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> subspace N {x :e R :^: idx N | f x = x}

items.name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ subspace B s -> subspace A {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (subspace A {f x | x :e s} <-> subspace B s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear A B f /\ subspace B s -> subspace A {x :e R :^: idx A | f x :e s}

items.name: SUBSPACE_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ x :e s -> vector_mul A c x :e s

items.name: SUBSPACE_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> (vector_mul N c x :e s <-> c = 0 \/ x :e s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ x :e s -> vector_neg A x :e s

items.name: SUBSPACE_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> (vector_neg N x :e s <-> x :e s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, subspace A {y :e R :^: idx A | orthogonal A x y}

items.name: SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTORS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A {y :e R :^: idx A | forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> orthogonal A x y}

items.name: SUBSPACE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ subspace N t -> subspace (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: SUBSPACE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> subspace M s /\ subspace N t

items.name: SUBSPACE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A (span A s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_SPECIAL_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, subspace N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = 0}

items.name: SUBSPACE_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> vector_sub A x y :e s

items.name: SUBSPACE_SUMS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ subspace A t -> subspace A (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: SUBSPACE_TRANSLATION_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, subspace A s /\ a :e s -> {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = s

items.name: SUBSPACE_TRANSLATION_SELF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> ({vector_add N a x | x :e s} = s <-> a :e s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> subspace A {vec A 0}

items.name: SUBSPACE_UNION_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ subspace N (s :\/: t)) -> s c= t \/ t c= s

items.name: SUBSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> subspace N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: SUBSPACE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= A, subspace B s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e s)) -> vsum A B t f :e s

items.name: SUBWOSET_ISO_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, woset_on A l /\ fld_on A l = A -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (l (f x) (f y) <-> l x y)) /\ forall x y :e A, y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ l x y -> x :e {f x | x :e s})

items.name: SUB_0
items.statement: forall m :e omega, minus_nat 0 m = 0 /\ minus_nat m 0 = m

items.name: SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n <= m -> minus_nat m n + n = m

items.name: SUB_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat (m + n) (m + p) = minus_nat n p

items.name: SUB_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat (m + p) (n + p) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUB_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall a b :e omega, P (minus_nat a b) <-> forall d :e omega, a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0 -> P d

items.name: SUB_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall a b :e omega, P (minus_nat a b) <-> exists d :e omega, (a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0) /\ P d

items.name: SUB_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m n = 0 <-> m <= n

items.name: SUB_PRESUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, nat_pred (minus_nat (ordsucc m) n) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, minus_nat n n = 0

items.name: SUB_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (ordsucc m) (ordsucc n) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUC_DEF
items.error: internal constant mk_num (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUC_INJ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m = ordsucc n <-> m = n

items.name: SUC_SUB1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, minus_nat (ordsucc n) 1 = n

items.name: SUMS_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ w :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N w z | z :e R :^: idx N, w :e (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) /\ z :e u}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x v | v :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ v :e \/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y z | z :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ z :e u}}

items.name: SUMS_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y x | x :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ x :e s}

items.name: SUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun n:set => 0) = 0

items.name: SUM_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 1) f = f 1

items.name: SUM_2
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 2) t = t 1 + t 2

items.name: SUM_3
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 3) t = t 1 + t 2 + t 3

items.name: SUM_4
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 4) t = t 1 + t 2 + t 3 + t 4

items.name: SUM_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: SUM_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= b) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= g x) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ABS_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => abs_SNo (f i))

items.name: SUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: SUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: SUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> finsum s f <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b :/: finite_cardinality s)) -> finsum s f <= b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b :/: finite_cardinality s)) -> finsum s f < b

items.name: SUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f + finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g

items.name: SUM_CASES_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall y :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then y else f x) = finsum s f + y + - f a

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finsum Empty f = 0) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e R) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finsum (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finsum s f else f x + finsum s f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m + finsum {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall m :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + f (ordsucc n) else finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i <= k} f + f (ordsucc k)

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | i < 0} f = 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i < k} f + f k

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + f n

items.name: SUM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, P 0 /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: SUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: SUM_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, 0 < n /\ (m <= n /\ n <= p + 1) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: SUM_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: SUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun n:set => c) = finite_cardinality s * c

items.name: SUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = minus_nat (n + 1) m * c

items.name: SUM_DEGENERATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, ~ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: SUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = finsum s f + - f a

items.name: SUM_DELETE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = if a :e s then finsum s f + - f a else finsum s f

items.name: SUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e R, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 0) = if a :e s then b else 0

items.name: SUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finsum (s :\: t) f = finsum s f + - finsum t f

items.name: SUM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k + - f (k + 1)) = if m <= n then f m + - f (n + 1) else 0

items.name: SUM_DIFFS_ALT
