items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f (k + 1) + - f k) = if m <= n then f (n + 1) + - f m else 0

items.name: SUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finsum s f = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: SUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_GP
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = if n < m then 0 else if x = 1 then minus_nat (n + 1) m else (x ^ m + - x ^ ordsucc n) :/: (1 + - x)

items.name: SUM_GP_BASIC
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = 1 + - x ^ ordsucc n

items.name: SUM_GP_MULTIPLIED
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = x ^ m + - x ^ ordsucc n

items.name: SUM_GP_OFFSET
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= m + n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = if x = 1 then n + 1 else x ^ m * (1 + - x ^ ordsucc n) :/: (1 + - x)

items.name: SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s g = finsum {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= g (f x)) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g <= finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e R) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = 0) -> finsum {i x | x :e s} d = finsum s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: SUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum (s :\/: t) f + finsum (s :/\: t) f

items.name: SUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: SUM_LE_INCLUDED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e B, i x :e A) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> 0 <= g y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ (i y = x /\ f x <= g y)))) -> finsum s f <= finsum t g

items.name: SUM_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => c * f x) = c * finsum s f

items.name: SUM_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: SUM_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: SUM_MULTICOUNT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = k * finite_cardinality t

items.name: SUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k j)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = finsum t k

items.name: SUM_MUL_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e A, b x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 <= a i /\ 0 <= b i) -> finsum s (fun i:set => a i * b i) <= finsum s a * finsum s b

items.name: SUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => - f x) = - finsum s f

items.name: SUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: SUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: SUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: SUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g k + - g (minus_nat k 1))) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g n + - f m * g (minus_nat m 1)) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g k * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: SUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g (k + 1) + - g k)) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) + - f m * g m) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: SUM_POS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f <= b) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b

items.name: SUM_POS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f = 0) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0

items.name: SUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) /\ finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 -> forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> f p = 0

items.name: SUM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finsum s f

items.name: SUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) -> 0 <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ 0 < f x)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: SUM_POS_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 < f i)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: SUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 0 else finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: SUM_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, R0 0 0 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: SUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: SUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else 0) = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else 0)

items.name: SUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => f x * c) = finsum s f * c

items.name: SUM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e A, finsum {x} f = f x

items.name: SUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: SUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + - g x) = finsum s f + - finsum s g

items.name: SUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite u /\ (finite v /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e u :\: v -> f x <= 0) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x))) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: SUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite v /\ (u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x)) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: SUM_SUB_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + - g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_SUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum (t i) (x i)) = finsum (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: SUM_SUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun x:set => finsum {y :e B | y :e t /\ R0 x y} (f x)) = finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: SUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum v f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} f = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum t (f i)) = finsum t (fun j:set => finsum s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: SUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: SUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: SUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: SUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (Union s) f = finsum s (fun t:set => finsum t f)

items.name: SUM_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum v f

items.name: SUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: SUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, finite u /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} c= s -> finsum s f = finsum A f

items.name: SUM_VSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum s f = drop (vsum A 1 s (fun x:set => lift (f x)))

items.name: SUM_ZERO_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ finsum s u = 0 -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> u i = 0) \/ exists j k :e A, j :e s /\ (u j < 0 /\ (k :e s /\ 0 < u k))

items.name: SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= sup s) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> sup s <= b

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_COND
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_CONST
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_GUARDED_PATTERN
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_SEQPATTERN
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_UNGUARDED_PATTERN
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_T
items.error: internal constant tailadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_TAIL
items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPPORT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> {x :e Empty | f x <> neutral_of C op} = Empty) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {x0 :e SetAdjoin s x | f x0 <> neutral_of C op} = if f x = neutral_of C op then {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} else SetAdjoin {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {x0 :e s :\: {x} | f x0 <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\: {x}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :\/: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\/: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :/\: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :/\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :\: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, {x :e {f x | x :e s} | g x <> neutral_of C op} = {f x | x :e {x :e s | g (f x) <> neutral_of C op}})))))

items.name: SUPPORT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, {x :e s | (if x = a then f x else neutral_of B op) <> neutral_of B op} = if a :e s then {x :e {a} | f x <> neutral_of B op} else Empty

items.name: SUPPORT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = neutral_of B op) <-> {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} = Empty

items.name: SUPPORT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} c= s

items.name: SUPPORT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} | f x <> neutral_of B op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: SUP_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall c :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ c < sup s) -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x

items.name: SUP_EQ
items.statement: forall s t c= R, (forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) <-> forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= b) -> sup s = sup t

items.name: SUP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall s c= R, (exists l :e R, is_lub s l) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: SUP_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> sup s :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= sup s

items.name: SUP_FINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, b :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: SUP_INSERT_FINITE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, finite s -> sup (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= sup s then sup s else x

items.name: SUP_INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, forall s c= R, sup (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s a) b) = sup (SetAdjoin s (if a <= b then b else a))

items.name: SUP_SING
items.statement: forall a :e R, sup {a} = a

items.name: SUP_UNION
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= c))) -> sup (s :\/: t) = if sup s <= sup t then sup t else sup s

items.name: SUP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= c) <-> b <= c) -> sup s = b

items.name: SUP_UNIQUE_FINITE
items.statement: forall a :e R, forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s = a <-> a :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> y <= a)

items.name: SURJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e t, exists x :e s, f x = y) <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ f y = x)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P (f x)) <-> exists y :e B, P y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P (f x)) <-> forall y :e B, P y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s -> ((forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)) -> ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall t:set -> prop, exists s c= A, forall x :e B, x :e {f x | x :e s} <-> t x) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall x :e A, f x :e t <-> x :e s) -> {f x | x :e s} = t

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}} = {x :e B | P x})

items.name: SURJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall m :e finseq B, exists l :e finseq A, seq_map f l = m) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, (forall t c= B, t c= v -> exists s c= A, s c= u /\ {f x | x :e s} = t) <-> forall y :e B, y :e v -> exists x :e A, x :e u /\ f x = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall u c= B, (forall k c= A, k c= s -> exists t c= B, t c= u /\ {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} = k) <-> {f x | x :e s} c= u /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall k:set -> prop, exists t c= B, forall x :e A, x :e {x0 :e A | f x0 :e t} <-> k x) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall y :e B, f (g y) = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N c x = y) <-> ~ c = 0

items.name: SUSLIN_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :e C -> s :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s :e suslin A C /\ t :e suslin A C -> s :/\: t :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> s :e suslin A C)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C D c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t :e C -> t :e D) /\ s :e suslin A C -> s :e suslin A D

items.name: SUSLIN_REGULAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, (forall c c= Power A, finite c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ c c= u) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e c, x :e Y} :e u) -> suslin A u = {suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) | f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, (forall l :e finseq omega, ~ l = seq_nil -> f l :e u) /\ forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ m <= n -> f (seq_mk n s) c= f (seq_mk m s)}

items.name: SUSLIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C D c= Power A, C c= D -> suslin A C c= suslin A D

items.name: SUSLIN_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, u c= suslin A u

items.name: SUSLIN_SUSLIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, suslin A (suslin A u) = suslin A u

items.name: SUSLIN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s :e suslin A C /\ t :e suslin A C -> s :\/: t :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> s :e suslin A C)) -> Union f :e suslin A C

items.name: SWAP_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) <-> exists y :e B, exists x :e A, P x y

items.name: SWAP_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y) <-> forall y :e B, forall x :e A, P x y

items.name: SYMMETRIC_IMP_NORMAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> normal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_neg A x :e s) /\ linear A B f -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e {f x | x :e s} -> vector_neg B x :e {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N (fun x0:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x0) x = matrix_vector_mul N N A x

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_add N N A B)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_cmul N N c A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_MAT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, symmetric_matrix_hl A (mat A A n)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> (symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N N N A B) <-> matrix_mul N N N A B = matrix_mul N N N B A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_neg N N A) <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N a v /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b)) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl A (matrix_mul A N A (transp N A A0) (matrix_mul N N A B A0))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_sub N N A B)

items.name: TARSKI_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall s t c= A, s c= t -> f s c= f t) -> exists s c= A, f s = s

items.name: TL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_tl (seq_cons h t) = t

items.name: TOPOLOGICAL_SORT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, lt x y /\ lt y x -> x = y) /\ (forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, equip s n -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ (s = {f x | x :e idx_n n} /\ forall j k :e omega, j :e idx_n n /\ (k :e idx_n n /\ j < k) -> ~ lt (f k) (f j))

items.name: TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> (forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x)

items.name: TOSET_COFINAL_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> exists w:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, w x y -> l x y) /\ (woset_on A w /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A w /\ l x y)

items.name: TOSET_IMP_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> poset_on A l

items.name: TOSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: TOSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, toset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> l x a

items.name: TOSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, toset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> l a x

items.name: TOSET_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> poset_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: TOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, toset_on A l -> toset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: TOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> toset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: TOSET_num
items.statement: toset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LE
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, R0 x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> R0 m n

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, R0 x x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> R0 m n) <-> forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LT
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n)) -> forall m n :e omega, m < n -> R0 m n

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> R0 m n) <-> forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))

items.name: TRANSLATION_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, s = {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> t = {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e s}

items.name: TRANSLATION_SUBSET_GALOIS_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e s} c= t <-> s c= {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e t}

items.name: TRANSLATION_SUBSET_GALOIS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, s c= {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e s} c= t

items.name: TRANSLATION_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e R :^: idx N} = R :^: idx N

items.name: TRANSP_COLUMNVECTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, transp A 1 (columnvector A v) = rowvector A v

items.name: TRANSP_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, transp M N A i j = A j i

items.name: TRANSP_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp N M A = transp N M B <-> A = B

items.name: TRANSP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N A = mat N M 0 <-> A = mat M N 0

items.name: TRANSP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) x = matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) y -> x = y) <-> {matrix_vector_mul N M m x | x :e R :^: idx M} = R :^: idx N

items.name: TRANSP_MAT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, transp A B (mat A B n) = mat B A n

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_add M N A B) = matrix_add N M (transp M N A) (transp M N B)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall c :e R, transp N M (matrix_cmul N M c A) = matrix_cmul M N c (transp N M A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp M N (matrix_inv M N A) = matrix_inv N M (transp N M A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_neg M N A) = matrix_neg N M (transp M N A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_sub M N A B) = matrix_sub N M (transp M N A) (transp M N B)

items.name: TRANSP_ROWVECTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, transp 1 A (rowvector A v) = columnvector A v

items.name: TRANSP_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, {matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) x | x :e R :^: idx N} = R :^: idx M <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M m x = matrix_vector_mul N M m y -> x = y

items.name: TRANSP_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp N M (transp M N A) = A

items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)
