items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: TRIV_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P) /\ (exists x :e A, Q) <-> exists x :e A, P /\ Q

items.name: TRIV_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P /\ Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P) /\ exists x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P -> Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P) -> exists x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P -> Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P) -> forall x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_FORALL_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P \/ Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P) \/ forall x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_OR_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P) \/ (forall x :e A, Q) <-> forall x :e A, P \/ Q

items.name: TRUTH
items.statement: True

items.name: TUKEY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, (forall c c= A, finite c /\ c c= t -> c :e s) <-> t :e s) -> exists u c= A, u :e s /\ forall v c= A, v :e s /\ u c= v -> u = v

items.name: T_DEF
items.statement: True <-> forall p:prop, p <-> p

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_REAL
items.statement: ~ countable R

items.name: UNCURRY_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y = f x y

items.name: UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = {x :e A | x :e s \/ x :e t}

items.name: UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = {x :e A | exists u c= A, u :e s /\ x :e u}

items.name: UNIONS_0
items.statement: forall A:set, Union Empty = Empty

items.name: UNIONS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, Union {s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, Union {s,t} = s :\/: t

items.name: UNIONS_DELETE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union (s :\: {Empty}) = Union s

items.name: UNIONS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union s :\: t = Union {x :\: t | x :e Power A, x :e s}

items.name: UNIONS_EQ_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, Union f = {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} <-> exists s c= A, f = {s}

items.name: UNIONS_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall P:set -> prop, forall f :e Power B :^: A, Union {f x | x :e A, P x} = {a :e B | exists x :e A, P x /\ a :e f x}) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power C :^: B :^: A, Union (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}) = {a :e C | exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ a :e f x y}) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power D :^: C :^: B :^: A, Union (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {f x y z | z :e C, P x y z}) = {a :e D | exists x :e A, exists y :e B, exists z :e C, P x y z /\ a :e f x y z})

items.name: UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, Union {f x | x :e s} = {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y :e f x}

items.name: UNIONS_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, Union (SetAdjoin u s) = s :\/: Union u

items.name: UNIONS_INSERT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union (SetAdjoin s Empty) = Union s

items.name: UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = A :\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {A :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: UNIONS_IN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> Union f :e f

items.name: UNIONS_MAXIMAL_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f -> Union {t :e Power A | t :e f /\ forall u c= A, u :e f -> ~ (t c= u /\ t <> u)} = Union f

items.name: UNIONS_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e s -> exists y c= A, y :e t /\ x c= y) -> Union s c= Union t

items.name: UNIONS_MONO_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f g :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x c= g x) -> Union {f x | x :e s} c= Union {g x | x :e s}

items.name: UNIONS_OVER_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (Power B) :^: A, forall s c= A, Union {{x0 :e B | forall Y :e f x, x0 :e Y} | x :e A, x :e s} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {Union {g x | x :e A, x :e s} | g :e Power B :^: A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x :e f x}, x :e Y}

items.name: UNIONS_PRED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e Union P <-> exists p c= A, p :e P /\ x :e p

items.name: UNIONS_SINGS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Union {{x} | x :e A, x :e s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_SINGS_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, Union {{x} | x :e A, P x} = {x :e A | P x}

items.name: UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union f c= t <-> forall s c= A, s :e f -> s c= t

items.name: UNIONS_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, Union (s :\/: t) = Union s :\/: Union t

items.name: UNIONS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> Union (Power A) = A

items.name: UNION_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t :\/: u = s :\/: (t :\/: u)

items.name: UNION_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = t :\/: s

items.name: UNION_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :\/: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s (p 0) :\/: t (p 0)}}

items.name: UNION_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, Empty :\/: s = s) /\ forall s c= A, s :\/: Empty = s

items.name: UNION_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall P:set -> prop, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ y :e l x0) <-> exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e l x0)

items.name: UNION_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\/: s = s

items.name: UNION_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l:set -> set -> prop, (forall m :e Power A :^: A, P m -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e m x) l) -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => exists l0 :e Power A :^: A, P l0 /\ y :e l0 x) l

items.name: UNION_LE_ADD_C
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, atleastp (s :\/: t) (s :+: t)

items.name: UNION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> Q c) /\ Union u = s)

items.name: UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, P Empty -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P {s} /\ Q s -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: UNION_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q Q':set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (forall x c= A, Q x -> Q' x) -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q' c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: UNION_OVER_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :/\: (t :\/: u) = s :/\: t :\/: s :/\: u

items.name: UNION_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :\/: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :\/: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t c= u <-> s c= u /\ t c= u

items.name: UNION_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, A :\/: s = A) /\ forall s c= A, s :\/: A = A

items.name: UNIQUE_SKOLEM_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ forall y0 :e B, P x y0 -> y0 = y) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y <-> f x = y

items.name: UNIQUE_SKOLEM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ forall y0 :e B, P x y0 -> y0 = y) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, P x (f x)) /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e A, y x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, P x (y x)) -> forall x :e A, y x = f x)

items.name: UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e A <-> True

items.name: UNIV_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | True} = A

items.name: UNIV_HAS_SIZE_DIMINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (equip N (dimindex N) <-> finite N)

items.name: UNIV_NOT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ A = Empty

items.name: UNIV_PCROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N}) = A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)

items.name: UNIV_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, A c= s <-> s = A

items.name: UNWIND_THM1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (exists x :e A, a = x /\ P x) <-> P a

items.name: UNWIND_THM2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (exists x :e A, x = a /\ P x) <-> P a

items.name: UPPER_BOUND_FINITE_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e omega, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= a

items.name: UPPER_BOUND_FINITE_SET_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e R, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= a

items.name: VECTORIZE_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> vectorize R M N (mat M N 0) = vec (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) 0

items.name: VECTORIZE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_add M N m1 m2) = vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N m1) (vectorize R M N m2)

items.name: VECTORIZE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_cmul M N c m) = vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) c (vectorize R M N m)

items.name: VECTORIZE_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M * dimindex N -> vectorize A M N m i = m (1 + div_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N)) (1 + mod_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N))

items.name: VECTORIZE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N m1 = vectorize R M N m2 <-> m1 = m2

items.name: VECTORIZE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N m = vec (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) 0 <-> m = mat M N 0

items.name: VECTORIZE_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, {vectorize A M N m | m :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, P m} = {v :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N) | P (matrify A M N v)}

items.name: VECTORIZE_MATRIFY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), vectorize A M N (matrify A M N a) = a

items.name: VECTORIZE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_sub M N m1 m2) = vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N m1) (vectorize R M N m2)

items.name: VECTOR_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, vector A 1 (seq_cons x seq_nil) 1 = x

items.name: VECTOR_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)) 1 = x /\ vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)) 2 = y

items.name: VECTOR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y z :e A, vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 1 = x /\ (vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 2 = y /\ vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 3 = z)

items.name: VECTOR_4
items.statement: forall A:set, forall w x y z :e A, vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 1 = w /\ (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 2 = x /\ (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 3 = y /\ vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 4 = z))

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m n p :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N m n = vector_add N n m /\ (vector_add N (vector_add N m n) p = vector_add N m (vector_add N n p) /\ vector_add N m (vector_add N n p) = vector_add N n (vector_add N m p))

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x (vector_add N y z) = vector_add N (vector_add N x y) z

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_add N x y i = x i + y i

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_add A x y) = vector_add A (vector_mul A c x) (vector_mul A c y)

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vec A 0) x = x

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vector_neg A x) x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (a + b) x = vector_add A (vector_mul A a x) (vector_mul A b x)

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x (vec A 0) = x

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x (vector_neg A x) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N (vector_add N x y) x = y

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x y = vector_add N y x

items.name: VECTOR_CHOOSE_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 <= e0 -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,y) = e0

items.name: VECTOR_CHOOSE_SIZE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 <= c -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = c

items.name: VECTOR_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x = fun j :e idx N => finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i * basis N i j)

items.name: VECTOR_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x = y <-> dot A x x = dot A x y /\ dot A y y = dot A x x

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_ADDR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x y = x <-> y = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_DOT_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> dot N v x = dot N v y) /\ (x :e span N b /\ y :e span N b) -> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_LDOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall y z :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = dot A x z) <-> y = z

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_NEG2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N x = vector_neg N y <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_RDOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, (forall z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x z = dot A y z) <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_1
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x = vector R 1 (seq_cons (x 1) seq_nil)

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_2
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, x = vector R (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) seq_nil))

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_3
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 3, x = vector R (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) (seq_cons (x 3) seq_nil)))

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_4
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 4, x = vector R (idx_n 4) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) (seq_cons (x 3) (seq_cons (x 4) seq_nil))))

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHOGONAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (~ vec N 0 :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (independent N s /\ (equip s (dimindex N) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N))))

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHOGONAL_SPANNINGSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N)

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHONORMAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = 1 -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ (independent N s /\ (equip s (dimindex N) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N))))

items.name: VECTOR_MATRIX_MUL_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_matrix_mul N M x A = matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M A) x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a (vector_mul A b x) = vector_mul A (a * b) x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_mul N c x i = c * x i

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vec A 0 <-> a = 0 \/ x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A a y <-> a = 0 \/ x = y

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LCANCEL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ a = 0 /\ vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A a y -> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A 1 x = x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (- c) x = vector_neg A (vector_mul A c x)

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A 0 x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A b x <-> a = b \/ x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RCANCEL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = vec A 0 /\ vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A b x -> a = b

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_neg A x) = vector_neg A (vector_mul A c x)

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, vector_mul A c (vec A 0) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_neg A (vec A 0) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_neg N x i = - x i

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x = vec A 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_MINUS1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x = vector_mul A (- 1) x

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N (vector_neg N x) = x

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N (vector_sub N x y) = vector_sub N y x

items.name: VECTOR_ONE
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x = fun i :e idx 1 => x 1

items.name: VECTOR_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x y = vector_add N x (vector_neg N y)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N (vector_sub N x y) y = x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_ADD2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall y x :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N y (vector_sub N x y) = x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_sub N x y i = x i + - y i

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x y = vec A 0 <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_sub A x y) = vector_sub A (vector_mul A c x) (vector_mul A c y)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A (vec A 0) x = vector_neg A x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_PROJECT_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b x :e R :^: idx N, dot N b (vector_sub N x (vector_mul N (dot N b x :/: dot N b b) b)) = 0

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x (vector_add N x y) = vector_neg N y

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (a + - b) x = vector_sub A (vector_mul A a x) (vector_mul A b x)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x (vec A 0) = x

items.name: VEC_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k i :e omega, vec N k i = k

items.name: VEC_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, vec A m = vec A n <-> m = n

items.name: VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s f = iterate_op (R :^: idx B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add B a b) s f

items.name: VSUM_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vec B 0) = vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 1) f = f 1

items.name: VSUM_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 2) t = vector_add A (t 1) (t 2)

items.name: VSUM_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 3) t = vector_add A (t 1) (vector_add A (t 2) (t 3))

items.name: VSUM_4
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 4) t = vector_add A (t 1) (vector_add A (t 2) (vector_add A (t 3) (t 4)))

items.name: VSUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = vec B 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = vec B 0} -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add A (f i) (g i)) = vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f)

items.name: VSUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> vsum A N s f = vsum A N s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: VSUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s -> vsum A N s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = vector_add N (vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f) (vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g)

items.name: VSUM_CASES_1
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x = a then y else f x) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vector_sub B y (f a))

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> vsum A B Empty f = vec B 0) /\ forall x :e C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e C, f x0 :e R :^: idx D) -> forall s c= C, finite s -> vsum C D (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then vsum C D s f else vector_add D (f x) (vsum C D s f)

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vector_add A (f m) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f)

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> (forall m :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else vec A 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (f (ordsucc n)) else vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vector_add N (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f) (f n)

items.name: VSUM_CMUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) = vector_mul A c (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f)

items.name: VSUM_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, 0 < n /\ (m <= n /\ n <= p + 1) -> vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= p} f) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: VSUM_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p -> vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= p} f) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: VSUM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, vsum A N s f i = finsum s (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: VSUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun n:set => c) = vector_mul B (finite_cardinality s) c

items.name: VSUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx A, forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = vector_mul A (minus_nat (n + 1) m) c

items.name: VSUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> vsum A B (s :\: {a}) f = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (f a)

items.name: VSUM_DELETE_CASES
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B (s :\: {x}) f = if x :e s then vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (f x) else vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else vec B 0) = if a :e s then b else vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> vsum A B (s :\: t) f = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_sub A (f k) (f (k + 1))) = if m <= n then vector_sub A (f m) (f (n + 1)) else vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_DIFFS_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_sub A (f (k + 1)) (f k)) = if m <= n then vector_sub A (f (n + 1)) (f m) else vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> vsum A B s f = vsum A B s g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = vec B 0) -> vsum A B s f = vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> vsum A N s f = vsum B N t g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> vsum A N s f = vsum B N t g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> f x = g x) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = vec B 0))) -> vsum A B s f = vsum A B t g

items.name: VSUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> vsum B C t (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = vsum A C s g

items.name: VSUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> vsum B C t (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = vsum A C s g

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e C, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall x y :e C, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> vsum A B {f x | x :e s} g = vsum C B s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A C s g = vsum B C {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = vec N 0) -> vsum B N {i x | x :e s} d = vsum A N s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: VSUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s /\ finite t -> vector_add N (vsum A N s f) (vsum A N t f) = vector_add N (vsum A N (s :\/: t) f) (vsum A N (s :/\: t) f)

items.name: VSUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_mul B c (f x)) = vector_mul B c (vsum A B s f)

items.name: VSUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x)) = vector_neg B (vsum A B s f)

items.name: VSUM_NORM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> vector_norm A (vsum B A s f) <= finsum s (fun x:set => vector_norm A (f x))

items.name: VSUM_NORM_ALLSUBSETS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= A, forall e0 :e R, finite p /\ (forall q c= A, q c= p -> vector_norm N (vsum A N q f) <= e0) -> finsum p (fun x:set => vector_norm N (f x)) <= 2 * dimindex N * e0

items.name: VSUM_NORM_BOUND
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> vector_norm B (f x) <= b) -> vector_norm B (vsum A B s f) <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: VSUM_NORM_LE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= g x) -> vector_norm N (vsum A N s f) <= finsum s g

items.name: VSUM_NORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ finsum s (fun a:set => vector_norm B (f a)) <= b -> vector_norm B (vsum A B s f) <= b

items.name: VSUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: VSUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: VSUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add N (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: VSUM_PAIR_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add N (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: VSUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f k) (vector_sub N (g k) (g (minus_nat k 1)))) = if m <= n then vector_sub N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (f (n + 1)) (g n)) (vector_mul N (f m) (g (minus_nat m 1)))) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f (k + 1) + - f k) (g k))) else vec N 0

items.name: VSUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f k) (vector_sub N (g (k + 1)) (g k))) = if m <= n then vector_sub N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (f (n + 1)) (g (n + 1))) (vector_mul N (f m) (g m))) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f (k + 1) + - f k) (g (k + 1)))) else vec N 0

items.name: VSUM_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= A, vsum A 1 s f = lift (finsum s (fun x:set => drop (f x)))

items.name: VSUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then vec A 0 else vsum omega A {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: VSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec B 0) = vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> vsum A B {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = vsum A B s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else vec B 0)

items.name: VSUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall v :e R :^: idx B, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_mul B (c x) v) = vector_mul B (finsum s c) v

items.name: VSUM_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e B, vsum B A {x} f = f x

items.name: VSUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: VSUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_SUB_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_sub A (f i) (g i)) = vector_sub A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g)

items.name: VSUM_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | ordsucc n <= i /\ i <= ordsucc m} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= m} (fun x:set => f (ordsucc x))

items.name: VSUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N v f = vsum A N u f

items.name: VSUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = vec N 0} f = vsum A N s f

items.name: VSUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> vsum C A s (fun i:set => vsum B A t (f i)) = vsum B A t (fun j:set => vsum C A s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: VSUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => vsum omega A {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => vsum omega A {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: VSUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> vsum A B (s :\/: t) f = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = vec B 0)) -> vsum A B (Union s) f = vsum (Power A) B s (fun t:set => vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N (u :\/: v) f = vsum A N v f

items.name: VSUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = vec B 0)) -> vsum A B (s :\/: t) f = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N (u :\/: v) f = vsum A N u f

items.name: VSUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add N a b)} c= s -> vsum A N s f = vsum A N A f

items.name: VSUM_VMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= B, vector_mul A (finsum s f) v = vsum B A s (fun x:set => vector_mul A (f x) v)

items.name: VSUM_VSUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e R :^: idx C) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> vsum A C s (fun i:set => vsum B C (t i) (x i)) = vsum (A :*: B) C (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) -> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, lt y x -> ~ P y

items.name: WF_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> ~ (lt x y /\ lt y x)

items.name: WF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (atleastp y x /\ ~ equip y x)

items.name: WF_DCHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> ~ exists s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) /\ forall n :e omega, lt (s (ordsucc n)) (s n)

items.name: WF_DHAIN_TRANSITIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) -> ((forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> ~ exists s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) /\ forall i j :e omega, i < j -> lt (s j) (s i))

items.name: WF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, lt y x -> ~ P y

items.name: WF_EREC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, f x = H f x) /\ forall y :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, y x = H y x) -> y = f

items.name: WF_FALSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ False

items.name: WF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, ~ lt x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) /\ (forall x :e A, finite {y :e A | lt y x})) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_IND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, lt y x -> P y) -> P x) -> forall x :e A, P x

items.name: WF_INSEG_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A :^: A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ x :e (fun x1 :e Power A :^: A => {y :e Power A :^: A | woset_on A (fun x2:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e x2 x2) /\ (woset_on A (fun x0:set => fun x10:set => x10 :e y x0) /\ (inseg_on A (fun x2:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e x2 x2) (fun x0:set => fun x10:set => x10 :e y x0) /\ ~ forall x0 x10 :e A, x10 :e x0 x0 <-> x10 :e y x0))}) y

items.name: WF_INT_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e int) -> (forall x :e A, 0 <= m x) /\ (forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, m y < m x -> P y) -> P x) -> forall x :e A, P x

items.name: WF_INT_MEASURE_2
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, m x y :e int) -> (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, 0 <= m x y) /\ (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, m x' y' < m x y -> P x' y') -> P x y) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y

items.name: WF_LEX
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ R0 y x) /\ (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ S y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (R0 (y 0) (x 0) \/ y 0 = x 0 /\ S (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_LEX_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall S:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ R0 y x) /\ (forall a :e A, forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ S a y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (R0 (y 0) (x 0) \/ y 0 = x 0 /\ S (y 0) (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ m y < m x

items.name: WF_MEASURE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e B) -> (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt (m y) (m x)

items.name: WF_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall lt lt0:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt0 y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (lt (y 0) (x 0) /\ lt0 (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> forall P c= Power A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (y c= x /\ y <> x /\ x c= s)

items.name: WF_REC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_CASES
items.error: internal constant CASEWISE (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: WF_REC_CASES'
items.error: internal constant CASEWISE (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: WF_REC_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x y <-> P g x y)) /\ (forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> P f z (f z)) -> exists y :e B, P f x y) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, P f x (f x)

items.name: WF_REC_INVARIANT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> forall S:set -> set -> prop, (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z /\ S z (f z)) -> H f x = H g x /\ S x (H f x)) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = if P x then f (g x) else h x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt P:set -> set -> prop, forall G:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, G x y :e A) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x <-> P g x) /\ (G f x = G g x /\ H f x = H g x)) /\ ((forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) /\ (forall f :e B :^: A, forall x y :e A, P f x /\ lt y (G f x) -> lt y x))) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = if P f x then f (G f x) else H f x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL_GENERAL'
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt P:set -> set -> prop, forall G:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, G x y :e B) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, H x y :e A) -> forall H':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, H' x y :e A) -> (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall f g :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, (forall z :e B, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x <-> P g x) /\ (G f x = G g x /\ H' f x = H' g x)) /\ ((forall f :e A :^: B, forall x y :e B, P f x /\ lt y (G f x) -> lt y x) /\ (forall f :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, H f x = if P f x then f (G f x) else H' f x))) -> exists f :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e omega) -> (forall f g :e omega :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e omega :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_REC_num
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: omega, forall y :e omega, H x y :e A) -> (forall f g :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, (forall m :e omega, m < n -> f m = g m) -> H f n = H g n) -> exists f :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, f n = H f n

items.name: WF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> ~ lt x x

items.name: WF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P0 c= A, P0 <> Empty -> exists x :e P0, forall y :e P0, ~ (P y /\ (P x /\ lt y x))

items.name: WF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt lt0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, lt x y -> lt0 x y) /\ (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt0 y x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_UREC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> forall f g :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, f x = H f x) /\ (forall x :e A, g x = H g x) -> f = g

items.name: WF_UREC_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall H:set -> set -> prop, (forall f g c= A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> (z :e f <-> z :e g)) -> (H f x <-> H g x)) -> forall f g c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e f <-> H f x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e g <-> H g x) -> f = g) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_num
items.statement: forall P c= omega, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ y < x

items.name: WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall m n :e omega, P m n <-> P n m) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> P m n) -> forall m n :e omega, P m n

items.name: WLOG_LE_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, P x y z -> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x <= y /\ y <= z -> P x y z) -> forall x y z :e omega, P x y z

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, P s /\ linear N N f -> P {f x | x :e s}) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, P {f x | x :e s} <-> P s

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, P s /\ linear M N f -> Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ (forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, Q t /\ linear N M g -> P {g x | x :e t}) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, Q {f x | x :e s} <-> P s

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_2_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, h x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall u c= R :^: idx A, P u /\ linear A B h -> Q {h x | x :e u}) /\ ((forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, Q t /\ linear B A g -> P {g x | x :e t}) /\ (linear A B f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, f x = f y -> x = y))) -> (Q {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall t c= R :^: idx A, P t /\ linear A A g -> P {g x | x :e t}) /\ (linear A A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> (P {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)

items.name: WLOG_LT
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall m :e omega, P m m) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, P m n <-> P n m) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> P m n)) -> forall m y :e omega, P m y

items.name: WLOG_RELATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, P x y -> P y x) /\ ((forall x y :e A, R0 x y \/ R0 y x) /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> P x y)) -> forall x y :e A, P x y

items.name: WO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> P x

items.name: WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> (forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y

items.name: WOSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: WOSET_FINITE_TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l /\ finite (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, l x y}) -> woset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: WOSET_IMP_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> poset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_IMP_TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> toset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_IMP_WQOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> wqoset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_INSEG_ORDINAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> woset_on (Power A :^: A) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (fun x :e Power A :^: A => {y :e Power A :^: A | ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e x x) /\ (ordinal_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e y x0) /\ inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e x x) (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e y x0))}) x)

items.name: WOSET_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> poset_on A l /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y

items.name: WOSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: WOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, woset_on A l -> woset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: WOSET_TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> toset_on A l /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y

items.name: WOSET_TOTAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: WOSET_TOTAL_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ properly_rel l y x

items.name: WOSET_TOTAL_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> x = y \/ (properly_rel l x y \/ properly_rel l y x)

items.name: WOSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: WOSET_TRANS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ properly_rel l y z -> properly_rel l x z

items.name: WOSET_TRANS_LESS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, properly_rel l x y /\ l y z -> properly_rel l x z

items.name: WOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> woset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: WOSET_WELL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall s:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, s x -> x :e fld_on A l) /\ (exists x :e A, s x) -> exists x :e A, s x /\ forall y :e A, s y -> l x y

items.name: WOSET_WELL_CONTRAPOS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> x :e fld_on A l) /\ (exists x :e A, P x) -> exists y :e A, P y /\ forall z :e A, properly_rel l z y -> ~ P z

items.name: WOSET_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> (forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x) /\ forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ properly_rel l y x

items.name: WOSET_WQOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> toset_on A l /\ wqoset_on A l

items.name: WOSET_num
items.statement: woset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: WO_ORDINAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> exists l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l

items.name: WQOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> (forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e t /\ l x y)

items.name: WQOSET_ANTICHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ ((forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ strictly_rel l y x) /\ forall s c= A, antichain_on A l s -> finite s)

items.name: WQOSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: WQOSET_IMP_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ strictly_rel l y x

items.name: WQOSET_NOBAD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e fld_on A l) -> exists i j :e omega, i < j /\ l (x i) (x j)

items.name: WQOSET_NOBAD_SUBSEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e fld_on A l) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ forall i j :e omega, i <= j -> l (x (r i)) (x (r j)))

items.name: WQOSET_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, wqoset_on A l /\ finite s -> wqoset_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (fun x :e A :^: K => {y :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (i i) (y i)}) x)

items.name: WQOSET_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e t /\ l x y)

items.name: WQOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, wqoset_on A l -> wqoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: WQOSET_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l /\ (qoset_on A m /\ (fld_on A m c= fld_on A l /\ (forall x y :e A, l x y -> m x y))) -> wqoset_on A m

items.name: WQOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> wqoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: WQOSET_WF_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l /\ (qoset_on A m /\ (fld_on A m c= fld_on A l /\ (forall x y :e A, l x y -> m x y))) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ strictly_rel m y x

items.name: WQOSET_WF_SUPERSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall m:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A m /\ (fld_on A m = fld_on A l /\ (forall x y :e A, l x y -> m x y)) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ strictly_rel m y x

items.name: WQOSET_num
items.statement: wqoset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: ZERO_ONE_OR_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ prime_nat p) <-> forall a b :e omega, divides_nat p (a * b) -> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b

items.name: ZERO_ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, p = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ prime_nat p) -> (divides_nat p (a * b) <-> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b)

items.name: ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, forall h2 :e B, forall t2 :e finseq B, seq_zip seq_nil seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_zip (seq_cons h1 t1) (seq_cons h2 t2) = seq_cons (h1,h2) (seq_zip t1 t2)

items.name: ZIP_DEF
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall l2 :e finseq B, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, seq_zip seq_nil l2 = seq_nil /\ seq_zip (seq_cons h1 t1) l2 = seq_cons (h1,seq_hd l2) (seq_zip t1 (seq_tl l2))

items.name: ZL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l /\ (forall P c= A, chain_on A l P -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e P -> l x y) -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A l /\ forall x :e A, l y x -> y = x

items.name: ZL_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l /\ (forall c c= A, chain_on A l c -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e c -> l x y) -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A l /\ forall x :e A, l y x -> l x y

items.name: ZL_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall c c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e c -> P x) /\ (forall x y c= A, x :e c /\ y :e c -> x c= y \/ y c= x) -> exists z c= A, P z /\ forall x c= A, x :e c -> x c= z) -> exists a c= A, P a /\ forall x c= A, P x /\ a c= x -> a = x

items.name: ZL_SUBSETS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall c c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e c -> P x) /\ (forall x y c= A, x :e c /\ y :e c -> x c= y \/ y c= x) -> P (Union c)) -> exists a c= A, P a /\ forall x c= A, P x /\ a c= x -> a = x

items.name: ZL_SUBSETS_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x c= A, P x) /\ (forall c c= Power A, (exists x c= A, x :e c) /\ ((forall x c= A, x :e c -> P x) /\ (forall x y c= A, x :e c /\ y :e c -> x c= y \/ y c= x)) -> P (Union c)) -> exists a c= A, P a /\ forall x c= A, P x /\ a c= x -> a = x

items.name: add_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s :+: t = {Inj0 x | x :e B, x :e s} :\/: {Inj1 y | y :e A, y :e t}

items.name: admissible

items.name: antichain
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, antichain_on A l s <-> s c= fld_on A l /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ l x y

items.name: basis_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, basis A k = fun i :e idx A => if i = k then 1 else 0

items.name: between_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x b :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,b) <-> distance A (a,b) = distance A (a,x) + distance A (x,b)

items.name: bilinear_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall y :e R :^: idx A, f x y :e R :^: idx B) -> (bilinear A B C f <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx C, linear A B (f x)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx A, linear C B (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: bool_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P (if False then 1 else 0) /\ P (if True then 1 else 0) -> forall x:prop, P (if x then 1 else 0)

items.name: bool_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e 2, f x :e A) /\ (f (if False then 1 else 0) = a /\ f (if True then 1 else 0) = b)

items.name: cart_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall a :e A :^: idx B, a = a) /\ forall r :e A :^: idx B, True <-> r = r

items.name: cartesian_product
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall x :e K, ~ x :e k -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i}

items.name: chain
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, chain_on A l s <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: char_INDUCT
items.error: no carrier mapping for type constructor char (in char)

items.name: char_RECURSION
