items.name: closed_interval_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N), closed_interval N l = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> seq_hd l 0 i <= x i /\ x i <= seq_hd l 1 i}

items.name: closed_real_interval_thm
items.statement: forall a b :e R, closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b}

items.name: collinear_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A s <-> exists u :e R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> exists c :e R, vector_sub A x y = vector_mul A c u

items.name: column_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall j :e omega, column M N j A = fun i :e idx M => A i j

items.name: columns_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, columns M N A = {column M N i A | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: columnvector_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, columnvector N v = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx 1 => v i

items.name: coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b -> d = 1

items.name: dependent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, dependent A s <-> exists a :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ a :e span A (s :\: {a})

items.name: dest_int_rep
items.statement: forall i :e int, exists n :e omega, i = n \/ i = - n

items.name: dim_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, dim N v = choose_in omega (fun n:set => exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ (v c= span N b /\ equip b n)))

items.name: dimindex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimindex A = if finite A then finite_cardinality A else 1

items.name: disjoint_union
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = \/_ i :e K, {(i,x) | x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i}

items.name: dist
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: divides
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat a b <-> exists x :e omega, b = a * x

items.name: dot_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i * y i)

items.name: drop_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = x 1

items.name: dropout_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, dropout M N k x = fun i :e idx N => if i < k /\ i <= dimindex M then x i else if i + 1 <= dimindex M then x (i + 1) else 0

items.name: eq_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, equip s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x)

items.name: euclidean_matroid_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> euclidean_matroid N = (R :^: idx N,fun x :e Power (R :^: idx N) => span N x)

items.name: exp_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e B, x :e t -> f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: finite_diff_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1) <-> r = r

items.name: finite_image_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx A, a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx A <-> r = r

items.name: finite_index
items.statement: forall A N:set, forall x :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, x i = x i

items.name: finite_prod_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B) <-> r = r

items.name: finite_sum_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B) <-> r = r

items.name: fld
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, fld_on A R0 = {x :e A | exists y :e A, R0 x y \/ R0 y x}

items.name: from_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, from n = {m :e omega | n <= m}

items.name: fstcart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), fstcart M f = fun i :e idx M => f i

items.name: ge_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp t s <-> atleastp t s

items.name: gt_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s <-> atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s

items.name: has_inf
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, is_glb s b <-> forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> c <= x) <-> c <= b

items.name: has_sup
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, is_lub s b <-> forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= c) <-> b <= c

items.name: hull_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, hull A P s = {x :e A | forall Y :e {t :e Power A | t :e P /\ s c= t}, x :e Y}

items.name: independent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, independent A s <-> ~ dependent A s

items.name: indicator_thm
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, indicator M s x = if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0

items.name: inf_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, inf s = choose_in R (fun a:set => (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= a)

items.name: infnorm_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, infnorm N x = sup {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: inseg
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m l:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m <-> forall x y :e A, l x y <-> m x y /\ y :e fld_on A l

items.name: int_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite int

items.name: int_abs
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = if abs_SNo x :e int then abs_SNo x else 0

items.name: int_abs_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = abs_SNo x

items.name: int_abstr
items.statement: forall a :e int, (if a :e int then a else 0) = a

items.name: int_add
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + y = if x + y :e int then x + y else 0

items.name: int_add_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + y = x + y

items.name: int_congruent
items.statement: forall x y n :e int, divides_int n (x + - y) <-> exists d :e int, x + - y = n * d

items.name: int_coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e int, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> exists x y :e int, a * x + b * y = 1

items.name: int_divides
items.statement: forall b a :e int, divides_int a b <-> exists x :e int, b = a * x

items.name: int_eq
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x = y <-> x = y

items.name: int_gcd
items.statement: forall a b :e int, 0 <= gcd_int a b /\ (divides_int (gcd_int a b) a /\ (divides_int (gcd_int a b) b /\ exists x y :e int, gcd_int a b = a * x + b * y))

items.name: int_ge
items.statement: forall x y :e int, y <= x <-> y <= x

items.name: int_gt
items.statement: forall x y :e int, y < x <-> y < x

items.name: int_lcm
items.statement: forall m n :e int, lcm_int m n = if m * n = 0 then 0 else div_int (abs_SNo (m * n)) (gcd_int m n)

items.name: int_le
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x <= y <-> x <= y

items.name: int_lt
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x < y <-> x < y

items.name: int_max
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then y else x) = if (if x <= y then y else x) :e int then if x <= y then y else x else 0

items.name: int_max_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then y else x) = if x <= y then y else x

items.name: int_min
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then x else y) = if (if x <= y then x else y) :e int then if x <= y then x else y else 0

items.name: int_min_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then x else y) = if x <= y then x else y

items.name: int_mod
items.statement: forall n x y :e int, divides_int n (x + - y) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: int_mul
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x * y = if x * y :e int then x * y else 0

items.name: int_mul_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x * y = x * y

items.name: int_neg
items.statement: forall i :e int, - i = if - i :e int then - i else 0

items.name: int_neg_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, - x = - x

items.name: int_of_num
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n = if n :e int then n else 0

items.name: int_of_num_th
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n = n

items.name: int_pow
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, x ^ n = if x ^ n :e int then x ^ n else 0

items.name: int_pow_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, x ^ n = x ^ n

items.name: int_rep
items.statement: forall r :e R, r :e int <-> (if r :e int then r else 0) = r

items.name: int_sgn
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) :e int then if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0 else 0

items.name: int_sgn_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: int_sub
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = if x + - y :e int then x + - y else 0

items.name: int_sub_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = x + - y

items.name: int_tybij
items.statement: (forall a :e int, (if a :e int then a else 0) = a) /\ forall r :e R, r :e int <-> (if r :e int then r else 0) = r

items.name: integer
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, abs_SNo x = n

items.name: interval
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < x i /\ x i < b i} /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= x i /\ x i <= b i}

items.name: invertible_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible M N A <-> exists A' :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A A' = mat M M 1 /\ matrix_mul N M N A' A = mat N N 1

items.name: iproduct
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e int) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: is_int
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, x = n \/ x = - n

items.name: is_nadd
items.error: internal constant is_nadd (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: is_nadd_0
items.error: internal constant is_nadd (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: is_realinterval_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s <-> forall a b c :e R, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (a <= c /\ c <= b)) -> c :e s

items.name: isum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e int) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: iterate
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> iterate_op B op s f = if finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} then set_foldr (fun x:set => op (f x)) {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} (neutral_of B op) else neutral_of B op

items.name: iterato
items.error: internal constant iterato (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: lambda
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> (fun i :e idx B => g i) = choose_in (A :^: idx B) (fun f:set => forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> f i = g i)

items.name: le_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: lift_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R, lift x = fun i :e idx 1 => x

items.name: linear_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N f <-> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (f x) (f y)) /\ forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_mul M c x) = vector_mul N c (f x))

items.name: linseg
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a x y :e A, linseg_rel l a x y <-> l x y /\ properly_rel l y a

items.name: list_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, l = seq_nil \/ exists h :e A, exists t :e finseq A, l = seq_cons h t

items.name: list_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P seq_nil /\ (forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e finseq A, P a1 -> P (seq_cons a0 a1)) -> forall x :e finseq A, P x

items.name: list_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> forall NIL' :e Z, forall CONS':set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e finseq A, forall z :e Z, CONS' x y z :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e finseq A, fn x :e Z) /\ (fn seq_nil = NIL' /\ forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e finseq A, fn (seq_cons a0 a1) = CONS' a0 a1 (fn a1))

items.name: list_of_seq
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, seq_mk 0 s = seq_nil /\ seq_mk (ordsucc n) s = seq_append (seq_mk n s) (seq_cons (s n) seq_nil)

items.name: list_of_set
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s) = choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)

items.name: lt_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t <-> atleastp s t /\ ~ atleastp t s

items.name: mat_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, mat M N k = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => if i = j then k else 0

items.name: matrify_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify A M N x = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => x (minus_nat i 1 * dimindex N + j)

items.name: matrix_add_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => A i j + B i j

items.name: matrix_cmul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_cmul M N c A = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => c * A i j

items.name: matrix_inv_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = matrix N M (fun y:set => choose_in (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => (forall w :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A w = vec N 0 -> orthogonal M x w) /\ forall z :e R :^: idx M, orthogonal N (vector_sub N y (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)) (matrix_vector_mul N M A z)))

items.name: matrix_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx P => finsum (idx N) (fun k:set => A i k * B k j)

items.name: matrix_neg_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N A = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => - A i j

items.name: matrix_sub_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => A i j + - B i j

items.name: matrix_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> matrix M N f = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx M => f (basis M j) i

items.name: matrix_vector_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = fun i :e idx M => finsum (idx N) (fun j:set => A i j * x j)

items.name: matroid_basis_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_basis A m s <-> matroid_spanning A m s /\ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: matroid_dependent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ ~ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: matroid_dim_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_dim A m s = matroid_dimension A (submatroid A m s)

items.name: matroid_dimension_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_dimension A m = choose_in omega (fun n:set => forall b c= A, matroid_basis A m b -> equip b n)

items.name: matroid_finite_dim_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ submatroid A m s :e matroid_finite_dimensional A

items.name: matroid_finite_dimensional_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> exists b c= A, finite b /\ matroid_spanning A m b

items.name: matroid_independent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {x}) x0}

items.name: matroid_set_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_set A m = m 0

items.name: matroid_span_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A m x x0 <-> x0 :e m 1 x

items.name: matroid_spanning_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e matroid A, matroid_spanning A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e matroid_set A m

items.name: matroid_subspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e s

items.name: matroid_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e matroid A, a = a) /\ forall r :e Power A :*: Power A :^: Power A, (forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> r 1 s c= r 0) /\ ((forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> s c= r 1 s) /\ ((forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= r 0 -> r 1 s c= r 1 t) /\ ((forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> r 1 (r 1 s) = r 1 s) /\ ((forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= r 0 /\ x :e r 1 s -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ x :e r 1 s')) /\ (forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, s c= r 0 /\ (x :e r 0 /\ (y :e r 1 (SetAdjoin s x) /\ ~ y :e r 1 s)) -> x :e r 1 (SetAdjoin s y)))))) <-> r = r

items.name: midpoint_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, midpoint A (a,b) = vector_mul A (recip_SNo 2) (vector_add A a b)

items.name: minimal
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) = choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m)

items.name: mk_pair_def
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: monoidal
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> ((forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) <-> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x))

items.name: mul_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s :*: t = \/_ x :e B, {(x,y) | y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: nadd_rep
items.error: internal constant dest_nadd (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: neutral
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> neutral_of A op = choose_in A (fun x:set => forall y :e A, op x y = y /\ op y x = y)

items.name: normal_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A)

items.name: nproduct
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e omega) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: nsum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e omega) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: num_Axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e A) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ (forall n :e omega, fn (ordsucc n) = f (fn n) n) /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, y x :e A) -> y 0 = e0 /\ (forall n :e omega, y (ordsucc n) = f (y n) n) -> forall x :e omega, y x = fn x)

items.name: num_CASES
items.statement: forall m :e omega, m = 0 \/ exists n :e omega, m = ordsucc n

items.name: num_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s <-> exists a :e omega, forall x :e omega, x :e s -> x <= a

items.name: num_FINITE_AVOID
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s -> exists a :e omega, ~ a :e s

items.name: num_INDUCTION
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> P (ordsucc n)) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_INDUCTION_DOWN
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall m :e omega, (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, n < m /\ P (n + 1) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite omega

items.name: num_INFINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> forall N :e omega, exists n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e s

items.name: num_MAX
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e omega, P x) /\ (exists M :e omega, forall x :e omega, P x -> x <= M) <-> exists m :e omega, P m /\ forall x :e omega, P x -> x <= m

items.name: num_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e A) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ forall n :e omega, fn (ordsucc n) = f (fn n) n)

items.name: num_WF
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, (forall m :e omega, m < n -> P m) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_WF_DOWN
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall m :e omega, (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, n < m /\ (forall p :e omega, n < p -> P p) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_WOP
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) <-> exists n :e omega, P n /\ forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m

items.name: num_congruent
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: num_coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: num_divides
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat a b <-> divides_int a b

items.name: num_gcd
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = if gcd_int a b :e omega then gcd_int a b else 0

items.name: num_lcm
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int a b = if lcm_int a b :e omega then lcm_int a b else 0

items.name: num_mod
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: num_of_int
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if x :e omega then x else 0) = choose_in omega (fun n:set => n = x)

items.name: numseg
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = {x :e omega | m <= x /\ x <= n}

items.name: o_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e C, f x :e D) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g (h x)) = f (g (h x))

items.name: o_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g x) = f (g x)

items.name: o_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g x) = f (g x)

items.name: one
items.statement: forall v :e 1, v = 0

items.name: one_Axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, y x :e A) -> y 0 = e0 -> forall x :e 1, y x = fn x)

items.name: one_DEF
items.statement: 0 = choose_in 1 (fun x:set => True)

items.name: one_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 -> forall x :e 1, P x

items.name: one_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, fn x :e A) /\ fn 0 = e0

items.name: one_axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e 1) -> forall x :e A, f x = g x

items.name: onorm_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N f = sup {vector_norm N (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M x = 1}

items.name: open_interval_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < x i /\ x i < b i}

items.name: open_real_interval_thm
items.statement: forall a b :e R, open_real_interval (a,b) = {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b}

items.name: option_DISTINCT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, ~ Inj1 a = Inj0 0

items.name: option_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P (Inj0 0) /\ (forall a :e A, P (Inj1 a)) -> forall x :e 1 :+: A, P x

items.name: option_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, Inj1 a = Inj1 b <-> a = b

items.name: option_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> forall NONE' :e Z, forall SOME':set -> set, (forall x :e A, SOME' x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1 :+: A, fn x :e Z) /\ (fn (Inj0 0) = NONE' /\ forall a :e A, fn (Inj1 a) = SOME' a)

items.name: ordinal_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l <-> woset_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> x = choose_in A (fun y:set => ~ properly_rel l y x)

items.name: orthogonal_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x y <-> dot A x y = 0

items.name: pair_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P (x,y)) -> forall p :e A :*: B, P p

items.name: pair_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall PAIR':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, PAIR' x y :e C) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, fn x :e C) /\ forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e B, fn (a0,a1) = PAIR' a0 a1

items.name: pairwise
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> r x y

items.name: pastecart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx M, forall g :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N f g = fun i :e idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) => if i <= dimindex M then f i else g (minus_nat i (dimindex M))

items.name: polynomial_function_thm
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> (polynomial_function_R p <-> exists m :e omega, exists c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) /\ forall x :e R, p x = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun i:set => c i * x ^ i))

items.name: poset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y)

items.name: prime
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 1 /\ forall x :e omega, divides_nat x p -> x = 1 \/ x = p

items.name: prod_tybij
items.error: internal constant REP_prod (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: product
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e R) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: product_map
items.statement: forall A B K:set, forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall x :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, (if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: properly
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, properly_rel R0 x y <-> R0 x y /\ ~ x = y

items.name: pushin_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall t :e B, forall x :e B :^: idx C, pushin A B C k t x = fun i :e idx A => if i < k then x i else if i = k then t else x (minus_nat i 1)

items.name: qoset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: rank_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim N (columns N M A)

items.name: rational_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational <-> exists m n :e R, m :e int /\ (n :e int /\ (~ n = 0 /\ x = m :/: n))

items.name: real_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite R

items.name: real_abs
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = if 0 <= x then x else - x

items.name: real_add
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_div
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: y = x * recip_SNo y

items.name: real_ge
items.statement: forall y x :e R, y <= x <-> y <= x

items.name: real_gt
items.statement: forall y x :e R, y < x <-> y < x

items.name: real_interval
items.statement: forall a b :e R, open_real_interval (a,b) = {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b} /\ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b}

items.name: real_inv
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_lt
items.statement: forall y x :e R, x < y <-> ~ y <= x

items.name: real_max
items.statement: forall n m :e R, (if m <= n then n else m) = if m <= n then n else m

items.name: real_min
items.statement: forall m n :e R, (if m <= n then m else n) = if m <= n then m else n

items.name: real_mod_thm
items.statement: forall x y n :e R, real_mod n x y <-> exists q :e R, q :e int /\ x + - y = q * n

items.name: real_mul
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_neg
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_of_num
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_of_num_th
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_pow
items.statement: forall x :e R, x ^ 0 = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, x ^ ordsucc n = x * x ^ n

items.name: real_sgn
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: real_sub
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - y = x + - y

items.name: real_zpow
items.statement: forall z :e R, forall i :e int, (if 0 <= i then z ^ i else recip_SNo (z ^ (- i))) = if 0 <= i then z ^ if i :e omega then i else 0 else recip_SNo (z ^ if - i :e omega then - i else 0)

items.name: relative_to_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, t :e relative_to A P s <-> exists u c= A, u :e P /\ s :/\: u = t

items.name: row_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, row M N i A = fun j :e idx N => A i j

items.name: rows_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rows M N A = {row M N i A | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M}

items.name: rowvector_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, rowvector N v = fun i :e idx 1 => fun j :e idx N => v j

items.name: set_of_list
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_set seq_nil = Empty /\ seq_set (seq_cons h t) = SetAdjoin (seq_set t) h

items.name: sndcart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), sndcart M N f = fun i :e idx N => f (i + dimindex M)

items.name: span_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | subspace A x} s

items.name: sqrt
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = choose_in R (fun y:set => (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ y ^ 2 = abs_SNo x)

items.name: strictly
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, strictly_rel R0 x y <-> R0 x y /\ ~ R0 y x

items.name: string_INFINITE
items.error: no carrier mapping for type constructor char (in char)

items.name: submatroid_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e matroid A, submatroid A m s = ({x :e A | matroid_span A m (matroid_set A m :/\: s) x},fun x :e Power A => {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m x x0})

items.name: subspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s <-> vec A 0 :e s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_add A x y :e s) /\ forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_mul A c x :e s)

items.name: sum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e R) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: sum_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e A :+: B, (exists a :e A, x = Inj0 a) \/ exists a :e B, x = Inj1 a

items.name: sum_DISTINCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall a' :e B, ~ Inj0 a = Inj1 a'

items.name: sum_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e A, P (Inj0 a)) /\ (forall a :e B, P (Inj1 a)) -> forall x :e A :+: B, P x

items.name: sum_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a a' :e A, Inj0 a = Inj0 a' <-> a = a') /\ forall a a' :e B, Inj1 a = Inj1 a' <-> a = a'

items.name: sum_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B Z:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall INL':set -> set, (forall x :e A, INL' x :e Z) -> forall INR':set -> set, (forall x :e B, INR' x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e A :+: B, fn x :e Z) /\ ((forall a :e A, fn (Inj0 a) = INL' a) /\ forall a :e B, fn (Inj1 a) = INR' a)

items.name: sup_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, sup s = choose_in R (fun a:set => (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= a) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> a <= b)

items.name: superadmissible
items.error: internal constant tailadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: support
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = neutral_of B op}

items.name: suslin_operation_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) = Union {{x :e A | forall Y :e {f (seq_mk n (fun x:set => s x)) | n :e omega, 1 <= n}, x :e Y} | s :e omega :^: omega, s :e omega :^: omega}

items.name: suslin_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, suslin A u = {suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) | f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, forall l :e finseq omega, ~ l = seq_nil -> f l :e u}

items.name: symmetric_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> transp N N A = A

items.name: tailadmissible
items.error: internal constant tailadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: toset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x))

items.name: transp_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx M => A j i

items.name: tybit0_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), P a) -> forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A), P x

items.name: tybit0_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), f x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A), fn x :e Z) /\ forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), fn a = f a

items.name: tybit1_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), P a) -> forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1), P x

items.name: tybit1_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), f x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1), fn x :e Z) /\ forall a :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), fn a = f a

items.name: vec_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, vec N n = fun i :e idx N => n

items.name: vector_add_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x y = fun i :e idx N => x i + y i

items.name: vector_matrix_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_matrix_mul M N x A = fun j :e idx N => finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => A i j * x i)

items.name: vector_mul_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N c x = fun i :e idx N => c * x i

items.name: vector_neg_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N x = fun i :e idx N => - x i

items.name: vector_norm_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = if 0 <= dot A x x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dot A x x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dot A x x)

items.name: vector_sub_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x y = fun i :e idx N => x i + - y i

items.name: vector_thm
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, vector A N l = fun i :e idx N => seq_nth l (minus_nat i 1)

items.name: vectorize_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize A M N x = fun i :e idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N) => x (1 + div_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N)) (1 + mod_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N))

items.name: vsum_thm
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> vsum A N s f = fun i :e idx N => finsum s (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: woset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y)))

items.name: wqoset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e t /\ l x y))
